```{r d-ccssbu-l-function}
    case_label <- "Case 5"
    case_name <- paste0(
      "Stage 3B available and calibration still provisional"
    )
    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x>n3A and at least one selected ordered DAR cluster ",
      "remains calibration-limited after all currently available ",
      "eligible events from that cluster have been exhausted."
    )
  }

  if (is.na(case_label)) {
    stop("The calibration case could not be classified.")
  }

  if (case_label=="Case 3") {
    monitoring_event_index <- D_3B_event_index
  } else if (case_label=="Case 4") {
    monitoring_event_index <- sort(setdiff(
      D_3B_event_index,D_Aug_L_event_index
    ))
  } else {
    monitoring_event_index <- integer(0)
  }

  monitoring_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(monitoring_event_index,event_statistics$Event_index)
  ]

  event_statistics <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration=
        Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration=
        Event_index %in% D_Aug_L_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring=
        Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    )

  limits_estimated <- TRUE
  limits_finalized <- calibration_finalized

  limit_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    case_label=="Case 1" ~ paste0(
      "Finalized d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from ",
      "the initial Stage 3A calibration dataset."
    ),
    case_label=="Case 2" ~ paste0(
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from ",
      "the currently available calibration dataset. Routine ",
      "Stage 3B monitoring has not begun."
    ),
    case_label=="Case 3" ~ paste0(
      "Finalized d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated without ",
      "post-Stage 3A supplementation."
    ),
    case_label=="Case 4" ~ paste0(
      "Finalized d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated after ",
      "chronological post-Stage 3A supplementation."
    ),
    case_label=="Case 5" ~ paste0(
      "Provisional d-CCSSBU-L bootstrap limits estimated from ",
      "the currently available calibration dataset. Only ",
      "calibration-limited clusters remain open to supplementation."
    ),
    TRUE ~ "Unclassified limit status."
  )

  message("Automatic analysis stage: ",analysis_stage)
  message("Case: ",case_label," (",case_name,")")
  message("Case definition: ",case_definition)
  message("Total number of events x = ",x)
  message("Number of eligible DAR clusters q = ",q)
  message("Selected d = ",d)
  message("Combined calibration size nCal = ",n_Cal)
  message("Calibration finalized = ",calibration_finalized)
  message("DCalL event indices: ",
          paste(D_Cal_L_event_index,collapse=", "))

  if (length(D_Aug_L_event_index)>0) {
    message("DAugL event indices: ",
            paste(D_Aug_L_event_index,collapse=", "))
  } else {
    message("DAugL event indices: none.")
  }

  if (length(monitoring_event_index)>0) {
    message("Monitoring event indices: ",
            paste(monitoring_event_index,collapse=", "))
  } else {
    message("Monitoring event indices: none.")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Steps 10-13. Sampling-location strata and CCSSB bootstrap.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  calibrate_d_ccssbu_l_bootstrap <- function(
      calibration_event_index,seed_internal) {

    set.seed(seed_internal)

    calibration_data <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% calibration_event_index)

    if (nrow(calibration_data)==0) {
      stop("No calibration data are available for bootstrap.")
    }

    loc_data <- split(
      calibration_data,
      calibration_data$Location
    )

    loc_data <- loc_data[vapply(
      loc_data,
      function(z) {
        any(!is.na(z$Normalized) & is.finite(z$Normalized))
      },
      logical(1)
    )]

    if (length(loc_data)==0) {
      stop("No valid sampling-location strata are available.")
    }

    loc_data <- loc_data[sort(names(loc_data))]

    h_values <- vapply(
      loc_data,
      function(z) {
        values <- z$Normalized
        values <- values[!is.na(values) & is.finite(values)]
        h_raw <- c_smooth*mad_unscaled(values)
        if (!is.finite(h_raw)) h_raw <- 0
        max(h_raw,h_min)
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    n_bootstrap_locations <- length(loc_data)

    boot_mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow=B,
      ncol=n_bootstrap_locations,
      dimnames=list(NULL,names(loc_data))
    )

    for (r in seq_len(n_bootstrap_locations)) {
      z_r <- loc_data[[r]]$Normalized
      z_r <- z_r[!is.na(z_r) & is.finite(z_r)]

      if (length(z_r)==0) {
        stop("A sampling-location stratum has no valid values.")
      }

      sampled_value <- sample(z_r,size=B,replace=TRUE)
      h_r <- h_values[r]

      eps <- if (h_r==0) {
        numeric(B)
      } else {
        stats::rnorm(B,mean=0,sd=h_r)
      }

      boot_mat[,r] <- pmax(0,sampled_value+eps)
    }

    L_boot <- if (n_bootstrap_locations==1) {
      boot_mat[,1]
    } else {
      matrixStats::rowMedians(boot_mat,na.rm=TRUE)
    }

    CL_boot <- median(L_boot,na.rm=TRUE)
    UCL_boot <- fast_quantile(L_boot,1-alpha)
    empirical_p0 <- mean(L_boot>UCL_boot,na.rm=TRUE)
    empirical_ARL0 <- if (empirical_p0>0) 1/empirical_p0 else Inf

    bootstrap_strata_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(names(loc_data),function(loc_name) {
        z <- loc_data[[loc_name]]$Normalized
        z <- z[!is.na(z) & is.finite(z)]

        data.frame(
          Location=loc_name,
          n=length(z),
          median=median(z),
          MAD=mad_unscaled(z),
          h=unname(h_values[loc_name]),
          min=min(z),
          max=max(z)
        )
      })
    )

    list(
      calibration_data=calibration_data,
      bootstrap_strata_summary=bootstrap_strata_summary,
      bootstrap_h_values=h_values,
      bootstrap_location_matrix=if (
        return_bootstrap_matrix
      ) boot_mat else NULL,
      L_d_ccssbu_l_boot=if (
        keep_bootstrap_statistics
      ) L_boot else NULL,
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=CL_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=UCL_boot,
      empirical_p0_from_bootstrap=empirical_p0,
      empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap=empirical_ARL0,
      n_bootstrap_locations=n_bootstrap_locations,
      bootstrap_location_names=names(loc_data)
    )
  }

  boot_obj <- calibrate_d_ccssbu_l_bootstrap(
    D_Cal_L_event_index,seed+1
  )

  calibration_data <- boot_obj$calibration_data
  bootstrap_strata_summary <- boot_obj$bootstrap_strata_summary
  bootstrap_h_values <- boot_obj$bootstrap_h_values
  bootstrap_location_matrix <- boot_obj$bootstrap_location_matrix
  bootstrap_statistics <- boot_obj$L_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- boot_obj$CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot <- boot_obj$UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot
  empirical_p0_from_bootstrap <-boot_obj$empirical_p0_from_bootstrap
  empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap <-boot_obj$empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap
  bootstrap_location_names <- boot_obj$bootstrap_location_names

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Steps 14-15. Construct chart and classify monitoring.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  CL_obs <- median(event_statistics$L_t,na.rm=TRUE)

  chart_data <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      CL_obs=CL_obs,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_L=L_t>UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_L=
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring &
        Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,
      Stage_Status=dplyr::case_when(
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event used only for calibration",
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration & In_D_3A ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event used for calibration",
        In_D_3A & !Location_Calibration_Eligible ~
          paste0(
            "Nominal Stage 3A event excluded from calibration ",
            "because it contains an OOS observation"
          ),
        In_D_3A ~ paste0(
          "Nominal Stage 3A event not contained in a selected ",
          "ordered DAR cluster"
        ),
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring ~
          "Routine Stage 3B monitoring event",
        In_D_3B & case_label %in% c("Case 2","Case 5") ~
          paste0(
            "Post-Stage 3A event observed while calibration ",
            "remains provisional"
          ),
        In_D_3B ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event excluded from current monitoring",
        TRUE ~ "Unclassified event"
      ),
      Limit_Status=limit_status,
      OOC_Event_Label=dplyr::if_else(
        Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,
        paste0("OOC:",Event),
        NA_character_
      ),
      Monitoring_OOC_Event_Label=dplyr::if_else(
        Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,
        paste0("OOC:",Event),
        NA_character_
      )
    )

  ooc_events <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,ResidueType,Event,Event_index,L_t,S_t,Max_Z_t,
      Location_Calibration_Eligible,d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,ordered_cluster_rank,L_cluster,
      S_cluster_diagnostic,cluster_ordering_basis,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_obs,m_t,
      n_locations_observed,all_ND_event,Stage_Status,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_augmented_calibration,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_L,
      OOC_Event_Label
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  monitoring_ooc_events <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  n_ooc_events <- nrow(ooc_events)

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(In_D_3A,Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) |>
    nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- nrow(monitoring_ooc_events)

 n_ND_ooc <- chart_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    all_ND_event,
    Signal_d_CCSSBU_L
  ) |>
  nrow()

  stage3B_ooc_labels <-
    monitoring_ooc_events$Monitoring_OOC_Event_Label

  if (n_ooc_events>0) {
    message("Number of events above the UCL: ",n_ooc_events,
            ". Event labels: ",
            paste(ooc_events$OOC_Event_Label,collapse=", "))
  } else {
    message("No event exceeds the d-CCSSBU-L UCL.")
  }

  if (length(monitoring_event_index)>0) {
    message("Routine Stage 3B monitoring signals: ",n_stage3B_ooc)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_title <- paste0(
    "d-CCSSBU-L for ",safe_plot_text(residue_type),
    " of ",safe_plot_text(equipment_label)
  )

  chart_subtitle <- stringr::str_wrap(
    paste0(
      case_label," | d=",d,"/",q,
      " | nCal=",n_Cal,
      " | UCLboot=",signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,4),
      " | CLboot=",signif(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,4)
    ),
    width=120
  )

  chart_caption <- stringr::str_wrap(
    paste0(
      "Stage 3A points above UCL = ",n_stage3A_ooc,
      "; routine Stage 3B OOC = ",n_stage3B_ooc,
      "; nCal = ",n_Cal,
      "; d = ",d,"/",q,
      "; ",ifelse(
        limits_finalized,"Finalized limits","Provisional limits"
      )
    ),
    width=100
  )

  event_breaks_plot <- pretty(chart_data$Event_index,n=10)
  event_breaks_plot <- event_breaks_plot[
    event_breaks_plot>=min(chart_data$Event_index) &
      event_breaks_plot<=max(chart_data$Event_index)
  ]

  event_labels <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::distinct(Event_index,Event) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Event_index)

  y_candidates <- c(
    chart_data$L_t,UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_obs
  )

  y_max_plot <- max(y_candidates[is.finite(y_candidates)])
  y_upper_plot <- if (y_max_plot<=0) 1 else y_max_plot*1.30
  x_min_plot <- min(chart_data$Event_index)
  x_max_plot <- max(chart_data$Event_index)
  x_range_plot <- max(1,x_max_plot-x_min_plot)
  x_label_pos <- x_max_plot+0.025*x_range_plot
  label_gap <- 0.028*y_upper_plot

  ucl_label_y <- min(
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot+0.022*y_upper_plot,
    0.985*y_upper_plot
  )

  cl_boot_label_y <- min(
    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot+label_gap,
    0.94*y_upper_plot
  )

  cl_obs_label_y <- max(
    CL_obs-label_gap,
    0.02*y_upper_plot
  )

  if (abs(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot-CL_obs)<2*label_gap) {
    cl_boot_label_y <- min(
      max(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_obs)+1.3*label_gap,
      0.94*y_upper_plot
    )
    cl_obs_label_y <- max(
      min(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,CL_obs)-1.3*label_gap,
      0.02*y_upper_plot
    )
  }

  ooc_plot_data <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(Signal_d_CCSSBU_L) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      OOC_Label_Y=pmax(L_t,UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot)+
        0.025*y_upper_plot
    )

  plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    chart_data,
    ggplot2::aes(Event_index,L_t,group=1)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(color="black",linewidth=0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(color=Signal_d_CCSSBU_L),
      size=0.42
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data=ooc_plot_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        Event_index,OOC_Label_Y,label=OOC_Event_Label
      ),
      color="red",hjust=-0.05,vjust=0,
      size=2.05,check_overlap=TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept=UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      linetype="dashed",color="red",linewidth=0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept=CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      color="blue",linewidth=0.55
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept=CL_obs,
      linetype="dotted",color="grey35",linewidth=0.50
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",x=x_label_pos,y=ucl_label_y,
      label=paste0("UCLboot = ",signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,4)),
      color="red",hjust=0,size=2.15
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",x=x_label_pos,y=cl_boot_label_y,
      label=paste0("CLboot = ",signif(CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,4)),
      color="blue",hjust=0,size=1.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",x=x_label_pos,y=cl_obs_label_y,
      label=paste0("CLobs = ",signif(CL_obs,4)),
      color="grey35",hjust=0,size=1.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values=c("FALSE"="black","TRUE"="red"),
      labels=c("FALSE"="In control","TRUE"="Candidate OOC")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks=event_breaks_plot,
      labels=event_labels$Event[
        match(event_breaks_plot,event_labels$Event_index)
      ]
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits=c(0,y_upper_plot),
      expand=ggplot2::expansion(mult=c(0.02,0.08))
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      clip="off",
      xlim=c(x_min_plot,x_max_plot+0.08*x_range_plot)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title=chart_title,
      subtitle=chart_subtitle,
      caption=chart_caption,
      x="Cleaning Event",
      y=expression(L[t]),
      color="Signal"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=10,face="bold"),
      plot.subtitle=ggplot2::element_text(size=6.5,lineheight=1.05),
      plot.caption=ggplot2::element_text(
        size=5.8,hjust=0,lineheight=1.05
      ),
      plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(8,75,8,8),
      legend.position="bottom",
      legend.direction="horizontal",
      legend.justification="center",
      legend.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=6.2),
      legend.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=5.8),
      axis.title=ggplot2::element_text(size=8.2),
      axis.text=ggplot2::element_text(size=6.8)
    )

  if (x>n_stage3A_events) {
    boundary_x <- n_stage3A_events+0.5

    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept=boundary_x,
        linetype="dotdash",
        color="darkgreen",
        linewidth=0.65
      ) +
      ggplot2::annotate(
        "text",
        x=boundary_x+0.010*x_range_plot,
        y=0.955*y_upper_plot,
        label="Nominal Stage 3A / Stage 3B",
        hjust=0,vjust=1,size=1.65,color="darkgreen"
      )
  }

  if (length(D_Aug_L_event_index)>0) {
    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data=chart_data |>
          dplyr::filter(Event_index %in% D_Aug_L_event_index),
        ggplot2::aes(Event_index,L_t),
        shape=21,fill="orange",color="black",
        size=0.90,stroke=0.25
      )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output tables and files
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
required_calibration_detail_columns <- c(
  "Equipment",
  "ResidueType",
  "Event",
  "Event_index",
  "L_t",
  "L_t_distinct_key",
  "S_t",
  "Max_Z_t",
  "Location_Calibration_Eligible",
  "d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key",
  "Cluster_Value",
  "ordered_cluster_rank",
  "L_cluster",
  "cluster_ordering_basis",
  "S_cluster_diagnostic",
  "m_t",
  "n_locations_observed",
  "all_ND_event",
  "Selection_Cycle",
  "Selection_Order_Within_Cycle",
  "Selection_Order",
  "Calibration_Source"
)

missing_calibration_detail_columns <- setdiff(
  required_calibration_detail_columns,
  names(cluster_selection_detail)
)

if (length(missing_calibration_detail_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "cluster_selection_detail is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(
      missing_calibration_detail_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "."
  )
}

    calibration_event_check <- cluster_selection_detail |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_CCSSBU_L_Calibration_Role = dplyr::case_when(
        In_D_3A ~ paste0(
          "Chronologically selected nominal Stage 3A event in ",
          "distinct-L_t selection cycle ",
          Selection_Cycle
        ),

        !In_D_3A ~ paste0(
          "Chronologically selected post-Stage 3A event in ",
          "distinct-L_t selection cycle ",
          Selection_Cycle
        ),

        TRUE ~ paste0(
          "Chronologically selected calibration event in ",
          "distinct-L_t selection cycle ",
          Selection_Cycle
        )
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Event_index,
      L_t,
      L_t_distinct_key,
      S_t,
      Max_Z_t,
      Location_Calibration_Eligible,
      d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      L_cluster,
      cluster_ordering_basis,
      S_cluster_diagnostic,
      m_t,
      n_locations_observed,
      all_ND_event,
      Selection_Cycle,
      Selection_Order_Within_Cycle,
      Selection_Order,
      Calibration_Source,
      d_CCSSBU_L_Calibration_Role
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      Selection_Cycle,
      Selection_Order_Within_Cycle
    ) 
  
  safe_equipment <- safe_name(equipment_label)
  safe_residue <- safe_name(residue_type)
  safe_cluster <- safe_name(cluster_col)
  safe_c <- gsub("\\.","p",as.character(c_smooth))
  safe_hmin <- gsub("\\.","p",as.character(h_min))
  safe_thresh <- gsub(
    "\\.","p",as.character(location_eligibility_threshold)
  )

  file_stub <- paste0(
    "d_CCSSBU_L_",safe_residue,"_",safe_equipment,
    "_cluster_",safe_cluster,
    "_d_",d,
    "_ARL0_",target_ARL0,
    "_c_",safe_c,
    "_hmin_",safe_hmin,
    "_elig_",safe_thresh
  )

  chart_file <- file.path(output_dir,paste0(file_stub,".png"))
  event_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_event_statistics.csv")
  )
  normalized_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_normalized_data.csv")
  )
  cluster_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_ordered_cluster_summary.csv")
  )
  calibration_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_calibration_events.csv")
  )
  cluster_selection_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_cluster_selection_detail.csv")
  )
  cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(file_stub, "_cluster_selection_cycles.csv")
  )
  cluster_status_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_cluster_calibration_status.csv")
  )
  bootstrap_strata_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_bootstrap_strata_summary.csv")
  )
  rds_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,paste0(file_stub,"_fit.rds")
  )

  if (save_outputs) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      chart_file,plot_obj,
      width=11,height=6.2,units="in",dpi=600,bg="white"
    )

    readr::write_csv(chart_data,event_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(normalized_data,normalized_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_summary,cluster_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(calibration_event_check,calibration_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_selection_detail,cluster_selection_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_selection_cycle_summary, cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(cluster_calibration_status,cluster_status_csv_file)
    readr::write_csv(bootstrap_strata_summary,bootstrap_strata_csv_file)
  }

  files <- list(
    chart_file=if (save_outputs) chart_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_cycle_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file else NA_character_,
    event_statistics_csv=if (save_outputs) event_csv_file else NA_character_,
    normalized_data_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) normalized_csv_file else NA_character_,
    ordered_cluster_summary_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) cluster_csv_file else NA_character_,
    calibration_events_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) calibration_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_detail_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) cluster_selection_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_calibration_status_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) cluster_status_csv_file else NA_character_,
    bootstrap_strata_summary_csv=if (
      save_outputs
    ) bootstrap_strata_csv_file else NA_character_,
    rds_file=if (save_outputs) rds_file else NA_character_
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reusable output object
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  result <- list(
    method="d-CCSSBU-L",
    chart_family="CCSSBU",
    chart_statistic="Location",
    function_name="d_ccssbu_l",
    call=match.call(),
    file=file,
    equipment_label=equipment_label,
    residue_type=residue_type,
    sheet=sheet,
    analysis_stage=analysis_stage,

    case_label=case_label,
    case_name=case_name,
    case_definition=case_definition,
    calibration_finalized=calibration_finalized,
    limits_estimated=limits_estimated,
    limits_finalized=limits_finalized,
    limit_status=limit_status,

    d=d,
    q=q,
    selected_ordered_cluster_ranks=seq_len(d),
    selected_cluster_keys=selected_cluster_keys,
    cluster_col=cluster_col,
    cluster_group_cols=cluster_group_cols,
    cluster_round_digits=cluster_round_digits,

    n_stage3A_events=n_stage3A_events,
    n_total_events=x,
    target_ARL0=target_ARL0,
    alpha=alpha,
    B=B,
    c_smooth=c_smooth,
    h_min=h_min,
    seed=seed,
    location_eligibility_threshold=  location_eligibility_threshold,
    location_distinct_digits=location_distinct_digits,

    D_3A_event_index=D_3A_event_index,
    D_3A_event_ids=D_3A_event_ids,
    D_3B_event_index=D_3B_event_index,
    D_3B_event_ids=D_3B_event_ids,
    D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster=
      D_Cal_L_event_index_by_cluster,
    D_Cal_L_event_ids_by_cluster=
      D_Cal_L_event_ids_by_cluster,
    D_Cal_L_event_index=D_Cal_L_event_index,
    D_Cal_L_event_ids=D_Cal_L_event_ids,
    D_Aug_L_event_index=D_Aug_L_event_index,
    D_Aug_L_event_ids=D_Aug_L_event_ids,
    monitoring_event_index=monitoring_event_index,
    monitoring_event_ids=monitoring_event_ids,
    n_Cal=n_Cal,
    n_distinct_L_t_Cal_by_cluster = stats::setNames(
      cluster_calibration_status$n_distinct_L_t_Cal_j,
      cluster_calibration_status$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key
    ),
    n_selection_cycles_by_cluster = stats::setNames(
      cluster_calibration_status$n_selection_cycles_j,
      cluster_calibration_status$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key
    ),

    all_selected_clusters_complete=      all_selected_clusters_complete,
    any_selected_cluster_limited=      any_selected_cluster_limited,

    normalized_data=normalized_data,
    event_statistics=chart_data,
    event_statistics_eligible=event_statistics_eligible,
    cluster_summary=cluster_summary,
    selected_cluster_summary=selected_cluster_summary,
    stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary=      stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary,
    cluster_selection_detail=cluster_selection_detail,
    cluster_selection_cycle_summary =      cluster_selection_cycle_summary,
    cluster_calibration_status=cluster_calibration_status,
    calibration_data=calibration_data,
    calibration_event_check=calibration_event_check,
    bootstrap_strata_summary=bootstrap_strata_summary,

    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot_definition=paste0(
      "Bootstrap center line: median of L_boot estimated ",
      "from D_Cal,L(d)."
    ),
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
    UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot_definition=paste0(
      "Bootstrap upper control limit: empirical 1-alpha ",
      "quantile of L_boot estimated from D_Cal,L(d)."
    ),

    CL_obs=CL_obs,
    CL_obs_definition=paste0(
      "Observed descriptive center line: median of all ",
      "observed L_t values. It is not a monitoring limit."
    ),

    bootstrap_statistics_L=bootstrap_statistics,
    bootstrap_location_matrix=bootstrap_location_matrix,
    bootstrap_h_values=bootstrap_h_values,
    bootstrap_location_names=bootstrap_location_names,
    empirical_p0_from_bootstrap=empirical_p0_from_bootstrap,
    empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap=empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap,

    ooc_events=ooc_events,
    monitoring_ooc_events=monitoring_ooc_events,
    n_ooc_events=n_ooc_events,
    n_stage3A_ooc=n_stage3A_ooc,
    n_stage3B_ooc=n_stage3B_ooc,
    n_ND_ooc=n_ND_ooc,
    stage3B_ooc_labels=stage3B_ooc_labels,

    reusable=list(
      all_event_index=chart_data$Event_index,
      all_event_ids=chart_data$Event,
      all_L_t=chart_data$L_t,
      all_S_t=chart_data$S_t,
      all_Max_Z_t=chart_data$Max_Z_t,
      all_cluster_key=chart_data$d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_key,
      all_location_calibration_eligible=
        chart_data$Location_Calibration_Eligible,

      D_3A_event_index=D_3A_event_index,
      D_3B_event_index=D_3B_event_index,
      calibration_event_index=D_Cal_L_event_index,
      calibration_event_ids=D_Cal_L_event_ids,
      augmented_event_index=D_Aug_L_event_index,
      augmented_event_ids=D_Aug_L_event_ids,
      monitoring_event_index=monitoring_event_index,
      monitoring_event_ids=monitoring_event_ids,

      calibration_L_t=chart_data$L_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index
      ],
      calibration_S_t=chart_data$S_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_L_event_index
      ],
      monitoring_L_t=chart_data$L_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
      ],
      monitoring_S_t=chart_data$S_t[
        chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
      ],

      bootstrap_L_t=bootstrap_statistics,
      CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=CL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot=UCL_d_ccssbu_l_boot,
      limits_estimated=limits_estimated,
      limits_finalized=limits_finalized,
      limit_status=limit_status,
      alpha=alpha,
      target_ARL0=target_ARL0,
      B=B,
      c_smooth=c_smooth,
      h_min=h_min,
      location_eligibility_threshold=
        location_eligibility_threshold
    ),

    d_CCSSBU_L_cluster_rule=paste0(
      "Clusters are defined by residue type and ",cluster_col,
      ". An event is calibration-eligible when Max_Z_t <= ",
      location_eligibility_threshold,
      ". If a cluster contains eligible nominal Stage 3A ",
      "events, its ordering statistic is the median L_t from ",
      "those events. If it is absent from nominal Stage 3A, ",
      "the statistic is calculated from all currently available ",
      "eligible events."
    ),
      d_CCSSBU_L_calibration_rule = paste0(
      "For each of the first d ordered DAR clusters, ",
      "D_Cal,L,j(d) is initialized as the empty set. Eligible ",
      "events are processed in chronological selection cycles. ",
      "Within each cycle, at most one event is selected for each ",
      "distinct L_t value, where distinctness is determined after ",
      "rounding L_t to ", location_distinct_digits,
      " decimal places. Selected events are appended to ",
      "D_Cal,L,j(d) and removed from the remaining candidate ",
      "event set. Other events having the same L_t values remain ",
      "eligible for selection in a subsequent cycle. The procedure ",
      "continues until n3A events have been selected or all ",
      "currently available eligible events in the cluster have ",
      "been exhausted. A cluster is calibration-complete only ",
      "when D_Cal,L,j(d) represents n3A distinct L_t values; ",
      "otherwise it is calibration-limited. This cyclic selection ",
      "prevents repeated identical L_t values, particularly those ",
      "arising from repeated ND events, from dominating any single ",
      "selection cycle."
    ),
    
    
    d_CCSSBU_L_limit_rule=paste0(
      "Bootstrap limits are estimated from the current ",
      "D_Cal,L(d). Under Cases 1, 3, and 4, the calibration ",
      "dataset and limits are finalized. Under Cases 2 and 5, ",
      "they are provisional and only calibration-limited ",
      "clusters remain open to chronological supplementation."
    ),

    d_CCSSBU_L_monitoring_rule=paste0(
      "Under Case 3, all D3B events are routine monitoring ",
      "events. Under Case 4, events in D_Aug,L(d) are used ",
      "only for calibration and excluded from monitoring. ",
      "Under Cases 2 and 5, routine Stage 3B monitoring does ",
      "not begin because calibration remains provisional."
    ),

    chart_title=chart_title,
    chart_subtitle=chart_subtitle,
    chart_caption=chart_caption,
    chart=plot_obj,
    files=files
  )

  class(result) <- c("d_ccssbu_l","ccssbu_l","list")

  if (save_outputs) {
    saveRDS(result,rds_file)
  }

  if (plot_chart) {
    print(plot_obj)
  }

  return(result)
}
```

```{r make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

make_d_ccssbu_l_arl1_wide_tbl <- function(tbl) {
# Validate the input table
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {stop("tbl must be a data frame.")}
  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {stop("tbl contains no rows.")}
  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    "rho",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns,names(tbl))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop(paste0("The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ", paste(missing_columns,collapse = ",")))}

  # ==========================================================
  # Optional candidate-level columns from Steps 9 to 12
  # ==========================================================
  optional_candidate_columns <- c(
    "W",
    "G",
    "in_C_d",
    "in_D1",
    "in_D2",
    "in_A",
    "in_U",
    "selected",
    "recommended_d",
    "observed_behavior_case",
    "arl_curve_case",
    "selected_case",
    "selection_rule",
    "A_values",
    "U_values",
    "selection_path",
    "recommendation_notes"
  )
  available_optional_columns <- intersect(optional_candidate_columns, names(tbl))

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct stable labels for the shift grid
  #  # Examples:
  # 0.5 becomes 0p5
  # 1.0 becomes 1
  # 1.5 becomes 1p5
  # 2.0 becomes 2
  # ==========================================================

  make_rho_label <- function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    if (anyNA(x) || any(!is.finite(x))) {stop( "The rho column must contain only finite numeric values." )}
    x_formatted <- format(x,scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE,digits = 15)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "0+$", replacement = "", x = x_formatted)
    x_formatted <- sub(pattern = "\\.$",replacement = "", x = x_formatted)
    gsub( pattern = "\\.",replacement = "p",  x = x_formatted)
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Prepare the long-format input used for pivoting
  # ==========================================================

  selected_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    available_optional_columns,
    "rho",
    "Xbar_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1"
  )

  selected_columns <- unique(selected_columns)

  tbl_wide_input <- tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$rho)),rho_label = make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(selected_columns),.data$rho_label) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that every Residue-d-rho combination is unique
  # ==========================================================

  duplicate_rows <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::count( .data$Residue,.data$d,.data$rho_label,name = "n_rows" ) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_rows > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {stop(paste0("Multiple rows were found for at least one ","Residue, d, and rho combination."))}

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that required d-specific columns are constant
  # across rho for each Residue and d
  # ==========================================================

  inconsistent_required_identifiers <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Residue,.data$d) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_q = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$q,na.rm = FALSE),
      n_calibration_case =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$calibration_case, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_nCal =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$nCal, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_OOC_ND =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_ND, na.rm = FALSE ),
      n_OOC_3A =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_3A, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_OOC_3B =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$OOC_3B, na.rm = FALSE),
      n_benchmark_n = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$benchmark_n,na.rm = FALSE),
      n_CL =dplyr::n_distinct(.data$CL, na.rm = FALSE ),
      n_UCL = dplyr::n_distinct(.data$UCL,na.rm = FALSE ),
      .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$n_q > 1 |
        .data$n_calibration_case > 1 |
        .data$n_nCal > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_ND > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_3A > 1 |
        .data$n_OOC_3B > 1 |
        .data$n_benchmark_n > 1 |
        .data$n_CL > 1 |
        .data$n_UCL > 1
    )

  if (nrow(inconsistent_required_identifiers) > 0) {stop( paste0( "One or more required d-specific columns vary across rho ","for the same Residue and d combination." ) ) }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that optional candidate-level columns are constant
  # across rho for each Residue and d
  # ==========================================================

  if (length(available_optional_columns) > 0) {

    inconsistent_optional_identifiers <- tbl_wide_input |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$Residue,
        .data$d
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(
            available_optional_columns
          ),
          ~ dplyr::n_distinct(
            .x,
            na.rm = FALSE
          ),
          .names = "n_{.col}"
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    optional_count_columns <- setdiff(
      names(
        inconsistent_optional_identifiers
      ),
      c(
        "Residue",
        "d"
      )
    )

    inconsistent_optional_identifiers <-
      inconsistent_optional_identifiers |>
      dplyr::filter(
        dplyr::if_any(
          dplyr::all_of(
            optional_count_columns
          ),
          ~ .x > 1
        )
      )

    if (nrow(inconsistent_optional_identifiers) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "One or more optional candidate-level columns vary ",
          "across rho for the same Residue and d combination."
        )
      )
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Confirm that the Xbar benchmark is common across d
  # within each residue, benchmark subgroup size, and rho
  # ==========================================================

  benchmark_inconsistency <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$benchmark_n,
      .data$rho_label
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_inconsistency) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The Xbar-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d for ",
        "at least one Residue, benchmark_n, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Define candidate-level identifier columns
  # ==========================================================

  id_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL",
    available_optional_columns
  )

  id_columns <- unique(
    id_columns
  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Pivot ARL1 values to wide format
  # ==========================================================

  tbl_wide <- tbl_wide_input |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols =
        dplyr::all_of(
          id_columns
        ),
      names_from =
        .data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(
        .data$Xbar_chart_ARL1,
        .data$ARL1
      ),
      names_glue =
        "{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort =
        FALSE
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        unique(
          tbl$Residue
        )
      ),
      .data$d
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Arrange columns into a readable order
  # ==========================================================

  leading_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "calibration_case",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "CL",
    "UCL"
  )

  optional_metric_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      "W",
      "G",
      "in_C_d",
      "in_D1",
      "in_D2",
      "in_A",
      "in_U",
      "selected",
      "recommended_d",
      "observed_behavior_case",
      "arl_curve_case",
      "selected_case",
      "selection_rule",
      "A_values",
      "U_values",
      "selection_path",
      "recommendation_notes"
    ),
    names(tbl_wide)
  )

  tbl_wide |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(
        leading_columns
      ),
      dplyr::starts_with(
        "Xbar_chart_ARL1_rho_"
      ),
      dplyr::starts_with(
        "ARL1_rho_"
      ),
      dplyr::all_of(
        optional_metric_columns
      ),
      dplyr::everything()
    )
}
```
