# Selection Results of $d$ for the d-CCSSBU-S Chart


```{r d-ccssbu-s-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_s <- function(
    file,
    equipment_label = "Equipment A",
    residue_type = "DAR",
    sheet = residue_type,

    # d-CCSSBU-S design parameters
    d = 1,
    n_stage3A_events = 10,
    target_ARL0 = 740,
    B = 20000,
    c_smooth = 0.5,
    h_min = 0.05,
    seed = 123,

    # Scale-calibration eligibility and compatibility diagnostic
    scale_eligibility_threshold = 100,
    scale_distinct_digits = 10,

    # Cluster definition
    cluster_col = "USL",
    cluster_group_cols = NULL,
    cluster_round_digits = 10,

    # Input columns
    event_col = "Event",
    location_col = "Location",
    result_col = "Result",
    lod_col = "LOD",
    loq_col = "LOQ",
    usl_col = "USL",

    # Output controls
    plot_chart = TRUE,
    save_outputs = TRUE,
    output_dir = file.path(getwd(), "d_CCSSBU_S_Charts"),
    return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
    keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Required packages
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  required_pkgs <- c(
    "readxl",
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "stringr",
    "readr",
    "matrixStats"
  )

  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[
    !(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  ]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validate arguments
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(target_ARL0) != 1 ||
      is.na(target_ARL0) ||
      !is.finite(target_ARL0) ||
      target_ARL0 <= 1) {
    stop("target_ARL0 must be a finite number greater than 1.")
  }

  if (length(B) != 1 ||
      is.na(B) ||
      !is.finite(B) ||
      B < 1 ||
      B != as.integer(B)) {
    stop("B must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (length(d) != 1 ||
      is.na(d) ||
      !is.finite(d) ||
      d < 1 ||
      d != as.integer(d)) {
    stop("d must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (length(n_stage3A_events) != 1 ||
      is.na(n_stage3A_events) ||
      !is.finite(n_stage3A_events) ||
      n_stage3A_events < 1 ||
      n_stage3A_events != as.integer(n_stage3A_events)) {
    stop("n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer.")
  }

  if (length(c_smooth) != 1 ||
      is.na(c_smooth) ||
      !is.finite(c_smooth) ||
      c_smooth < 0) {
    stop("c_smooth must be a finite nonnegative number.")
  }

  if (length(h_min) != 1 ||
      is.na(h_min) ||
      !is.finite(h_min) ||
      h_min < 0) {
    stop("h_min must be a finite nonnegative number.")
  }

  if (length(scale_eligibility_threshold) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      !is.finite(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      scale_eligibility_threshold <= 0) {
    stop("scale_eligibility_threshold must be positive.")
  }

  if (length(scale_distinct_digits) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      !is.finite(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      scale_distinct_digits < 0 ||
      scale_distinct_digits != as.integer(scale_distinct_digits)) {
    stop("scale_distinct_digits must be a nonnegative integer.")
  }

  if (save_outputs && !dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(
      output_dir,
      recursive = TRUE
    )
  }

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mad_unscaled <- function(x) {

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x) &
        is.finite(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    med_x <- median(
      x,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    median(
      abs(x - med_x),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  is_nd_result <- function(x) {

    x_chr <- trimws(
      toupper(
        as.character(x)
      )
    )

    x_chr %in% c(
      "ND",
      "N.D.",
      "N/D",
      "NON-DETECT",
      "NONDETECT",
      "NON DETECT",
      "NOT DETECT"
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {

    x_chr <- trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )

    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x_chr)
    )

    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        stringr::str_extract(
          x_chr,
          "\\d+$"
        )
      )
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x) &
        is.finite(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    as.numeric(
      stats::quantile(
        x = x,
        probs = probs,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        type = 7,
        names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  safe_name <- function(x) {

    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "_",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  safe_plot_text <- function(x) {

    gsub(
      pattern = "_",
      replacement = "-",
      x = as.character(x)
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Read and validate data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  all_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  if (!(sheet %in% all_sheets)) {
    stop(
      "Requested sheet was not found: ",
      sheet,
      ". Available sheets: ",
      paste(all_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
    path = file,
    sheet = sheet
  ) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(
      ~ stringr::str_trim(.x)
    )

  result_col_actual <- result_col

  if (!(result_col_actual %in% names(dat_raw)) &&
      residue_type %in% names(dat_raw)) {
    result_col_actual <- residue_type
  }

  required_cols <- c(
    event_col,
    location_col,
    result_col_actual,
    lod_col,
    loq_col,
    usl_col,
    cluster_col
  )

  if (!is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {
    required_cols <- c(
      required_cols,
      cluster_group_cols
    )
  }

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(dat_raw)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Sheet ", sheet,
      " is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  message("d-CCSSBU-S equipment = ", equipment_label)
  message("Residue type = ", residue_type)
  message("Sheet used = ", sheet)
  message("Cluster column = ", cluster_col)

  message(
    "d = ", d,
    "; n_stage3A_events = ", n_stage3A_events,
    "; target ARL0 = ", target_ARL0,
    "; alpha = ", signif(alpha, 5),
    "; B = ", B,
    "; c_smooth = ", c_smooth,
    "; h_min = ", h_min,
    "; scale eligibility threshold = ",
    scale_eligibility_threshold,
    "; seed = ", seed
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1. Replace non-detects.
  # Step 2. Conduct USL normalization.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  normalized_data <- dat_raw |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Equipment = equipment_label,
      ResidueType = residue_type,
      Event = extract_event_number(
        .data[[event_col]]
      ),
      Location = trimws(
        as.character(
          .data[[location_col]]
        )
      ),
      Result_chr = trimws(
        as.character(
          .data[[result_col_actual]]
        )
      ),
      ND_flag = is_nd_result(Result_chr),
      Result_raw = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(Result_chr)
      ),
      LOD = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(.data[[lod_col]])
      ),
      LOQ = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(.data[[loq_col]])
      ),
      USL = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(.data[[usl_col]])
      ),
      Cluster_Value_Raw =
        .data[[cluster_col]],
      Cluster_Value_Numeric =
        suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            .data[[cluster_col]]
          )
        ),
      Cluster_Value = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(Cluster_Value_Numeric) ~
          as.character(
            round(
              Cluster_Value_Numeric,
              cluster_round_digits
            )
          ),
        TRUE ~ trimws(
          as.character(
            Cluster_Value_Raw
          )
        )
      ),
      Result_Replacement_Source =
        dplyr::case_when(
          ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~
            "ND replaced by LOD",
          ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~
            "ND replaced by LOQ",
          ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ) ~
            "Removed: ND with missing LOD and LOQ",
          !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~
            "Observed Result",
          !ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw) ~
            "Removed: missing or nonnumeric Result",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
      Result_ND_Replaced =
        dplyr::case_when(
          ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~ LOD,
          ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & !is.na(LOQ) ~ LOQ,
          !ND_flag & !is.na(Result_raw) ~ Result_raw,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

  n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq <- sum(
    normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOD) &
      is.na(normalized_data$LOQ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  n_removed_missing_result <- sum(
    !normalized_data$ND_flag &
      is.na(normalized_data$Result_raw),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_nd_missing_lod_loq,
      " ND row(s) removed because both LOD and LOQ were missing."
    )
  }

  if (n_removed_missing_result > 0) {
    warning(
      n_removed_missing_result,
      " non-ND row(s) removed because Result was missing or nonnumeric."
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !(ND_flag & is.na(LOD) & is.na(LOQ)),
      !(!ND_flag & is.na(Result_raw)),
      !is.na(Event),
      !is.na(Location),
      Location != "",
      !is.na(USL),
      USL > 0,
      !is.na(Cluster_Value),
      Cluster_Value != "",
      !is.na(Result_ND_Replaced)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Normalized =
        100 * Result_ND_Replaced / USL
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Normalized),
      is.finite(Normalized)
    )

  if (nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No usable observations remain after ND replacement ",
      "and USL normalization."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Construct the user-specified cluster key
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(cluster_group_cols)) {

    normalized_data <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key = paste(
          ResidueType,
          cluster_col,
          Cluster_Value,
          sep = " | "
        )
      )

  } else {

    group_key_df <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
          cluster_group_cols
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::everything(),
          ~ trimws(
            as.character(.x)
          )
        )
      ) |>
      as.data.frame()

    group_key <- do.call(
      paste,
      c(
        group_key_df,
        sep = " | "
      )
    )

    normalized_data$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key <- paste(
      normalized_data$ResidueType,
      group_key,
      cluster_col,
      normalized_data$Cluster_Value,
      sep = " | "
    )
  }

  normalized_data <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::select(
      Equipment,
      ResidueType,
      Event,
      Location,
      Result_chr,
      Result_raw,
      LOD,
      LOQ,
      USL,
      Cluster_Value,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      ND_flag,
      Result_Replacement_Source,
      Result_ND_Replaced,
      Normalized,
      dplyr::everything()
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Chronological sequence D = {e1, ..., ex}
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_levels <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::distinct(Event) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Event) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Event_index =
        dplyr::row_number()
    )

  normalized_data <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      event_levels,
      by = "Event"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index,
      Location
    )

  event_cluster_check <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Event,
      Event_index
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_clusters_in_event =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ),
      cluster_keys = paste(
        unique(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ),
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_clusters_in_event > 1
    )

  if (nrow(event_cluster_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Some cleaning events belong to more than one ",
      "d-CCSSBU-S cluster. This violates the partition ",
      "assumption. Check whether cluster_col = '",
      cluster_col,
      "' and cluster_group_cols are constant within each event. ",
      "Example event(s): ",
      paste(
        head(
          event_cluster_check$Event,
          10
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3. Calculate event-level location and scale statistics
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_statistics <- normalized_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Event,
      Event_index
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Equipment =
        dplyr::first(Equipment),
      ResidueType =
        dplyr::first(ResidueType),
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key =
        dplyr::first(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ),
      Cluster_Value =
        dplyr::first(Cluster_Value),
      L_t = median(
        Normalized,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      S_t = mad_unscaled(
        Normalized
      ),
      Max_Z_t = max(
        Normalized,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Min_Z_t = min(
        Normalized,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      m_t = dplyr::n(),
      n_locations_observed =
        dplyr::n_distinct(Location),
      n_zero_values = sum(
        Normalized == 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      n_positive_values = sum(
        Normalized > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      n_ND_values = sum(
        ND_flag,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      all_ND_event = all(
        ND_flag
      ),
      n_distinct_normalized_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          round(
            Normalized,
            scale_distinct_digits
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      all_normalized_values_identical =
        n_distinct_normalized_values == 1,
      S_t_distinct_key = round(
        S_t,
        scale_distinct_digits
      ),
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible =
        Max_Z_t <= scale_eligibility_threshold
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index
    )

  x <- nrow(event_statistics)

  if (x < n_stage3A_events) {
    stop(
      "At least ", n_stage3A_events,
      " cleaning events are required. Current number of events x = ",
      x,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 4. Create nominal Stage 3A and Stage 3B datasets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  D_3A_event_index <- seq_len(
    n_stage3A_events
  )

  D_3A_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(
      D_3A_event_index,
      event_statistics$Event_index
    )
  ]

  if (x == n_stage3A_events) {

    D_3B_event_index <- integer(0)
    D_3B_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[0]
    analysis_stage <- "Initial Stage 3A analysis"

  } else {

    D_3B_event_index <- seq.int(
      n_stage3A_events + 1L,
      x
    )

    D_3B_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
      match(
        D_3B_event_index,
        event_statistics$Event_index
      )
    ]

    analysis_stage <-
      "Stage 3B analysis with post-Stage 3A events available"
  }

  event_statistics <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_D_3A =
        Event_index %in% D_3A_event_index,
      In_D_3B =
        Event_index %in% D_3B_event_index
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 5. Create calibration-eligible clusters
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  event_statistics_eligible <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Scale_Calibration_Eligible
    )

  if (nrow(event_statistics_eligible) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No event is eligible for d-CCSSBU-S calibration. ",
      "All events have Max_Z_t > ",
      scale_eligibility_threshold,
      "."
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 6. Order clusters by Stage 3A scale
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cluster_summary <- event_statistics_eligible |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      S_cluster = if (any(In_D_3A)) {
        median(
          S_t[In_D_3A],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        median(
          S_t,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },
      L_cluster_diagnostic = if (any(In_D_3A)) {
        median(
          L_t[In_D_3A],
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        median(
          L_t,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      },
      cluster_ordering_basis = if (any(In_D_3A)) {
        "Eligible nominal Stage 3A events"
      } else {
        paste0(
          "All currently available eligible events; ",
          "cluster absent from nominal Stage 3A"
        )
      },
      n_events_cluster =        dplyr::n(),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3A =        sum(In_D_3A),
      n_events_cluster_in_D_3B =        sum(In_D_3B),
      first_event_index_cluster =        min(Event_index),
      max_S_t_cluster =        max(S_t),
      min_S_t_cluster =        min(S_t),
      n_distinct_S_t_cluster =        dplyr::n_distinct(
          S_t_distinct_key
        ),
      n_all_ND_events_cluster =        sum(all_ND_event),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(S_cluster),
      first_event_index_cluster,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ordered_cluster_rank =
        dplyr::row_number()
    )

  q <- nrow(cluster_summary)

  if (q == 0) {
    stop(
      "No eligible clusters are available for ",
      "d-CCSSBU-S calibration."
    )
  }

  if (d > q) {
    warning(
      "Input d = ", d,
      " is larger than q = ", q,
      ". Setting d = q."
    )

    d <- q
  }

  selected_cluster_summary <- cluster_summary |>
    dplyr::filter(ordered_cluster_rank <= d) |>
    dplyr::arrange(ordered_cluster_rank)

  selected_cluster_keys <-selected_cluster_summary$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key

  event_statistics <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      cluster_summary |>
        dplyr::select(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
          S_cluster,
          L_cluster_diagnostic,
          cluster_ordering_basis,
          ordered_cluster_rank
        ),
      by = "d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      In_first_d_ordered_clusters =
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key %in%
        selected_cluster_keys
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 7. Identify Stage 3A events within ordered clusters
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary <-
    event_statistics_eligible |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      cluster_summary |>
        dplyr::select(
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
          ordered_cluster_rank,
          S_cluster,
          cluster_ordering_basis
        ),
      by = "d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key"
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      ordered_cluster_rank,
      d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      Cluster_Value,
      S_cluster,
      cluster_ordering_basis
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_stage3A_component =
        sum(In_D_3A),
      stage3A_event_index = paste(
        Event_index[In_D_3A],
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      stage3A_event_ids = paste(
        Event[In_D_3A],
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      ordered_cluster_rank
    )

   # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 8. Build the d-CCSSBU-S calibration dataset
  #
  # For each selected ordered DAR cluster:
  #
  # Step 8.1:
  # Initialize D_Cal,S,j(d) as the empty set.
  #
  # Step 8.2:
  # In the first selection cycle, scan the currently available
  # calibration-eligible events chronologically. Select at most
  # one event for each distinct rounded S_t value represented
  # within that cycle, up to n3A events.
  #
  # Step 8.3:
  # If n3A events have been selected, retain the constructed
  # D_Cal,S,j(d) and terminate Step 8 for that cluster.
  #
  # Step 8.4:
  # Otherwise, remove only the events already selected. Begin
  # another selection cycle using the remaining events. Within
  # the new cycle, again select events chronologically with
  # distinct rounded S_t values.
  #
  # An S_t value used in an earlier cycle may therefore recur
  # through a different event in a later selection cycle.
  #
  # Step 8.5:
  # Continue until either n3A events have been selected or all
  # currently available calibration-eligible events in the
  # cluster have been exhausted.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  select_cluster_calibration_events <- function(cluster_key_j) {

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 8.1. Initialize D_Cal,S,j(d)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    selected <- event_statistics_eligible |>
      dplyr::filter(
        FALSE
      )

    candidates <- event_statistics_eligible |>
      dplyr::filter(
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key == cluster_key_j
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        Event_index
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        S_t_distinct_key = round(
          S_t,
          scale_distinct_digits
        )
      )

    if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {

      return(
        list(
          selected_index = integer(0),
          selected_ids = numeric(0),
          selection_detail = candidates,
          selection_cycle_summary = tibble::tibble(),
          n_selection_cycles = 0L,
          cluster_events_exhausted = TRUE
        )
      )
    }

    remaining_candidates <- candidates

    selection_cycle_summary_list <- list()

    selection_cycle <- 0L

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 8.2-8.5. Perform chronological selection cycles
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    while (
      nrow(selected) < n_stage3A_events &&
      nrow(remaining_candidates) > 0
    ) {

      selection_cycle <- selection_cycle + 1L

      n_needed <- n_stage3A_events - nrow(selected)

      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 8.2 or Step 8.4
      #
      # Select events chronologically. Within the current cycle,
      # retain at most one event for each distinct rounded S_t
      # value. A value represented in an earlier cycle is allowed
      # to recur in this cycle through a different event.
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      cycle_selected <- remaining_candidates |>
        dplyr::arrange(
          Event_index
        ) |>
        dplyr::distinct(
          S_t_distinct_key,
          .keep_all = TRUE
        ) |>
        dplyr::slice_head(
          n = n_needed
        )

      if (nrow(cycle_selected) == 0) {
        break
      }

      cycle_selected <- cycle_selected |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Selection_Cycle = selection_cycle,
          Selection_Order_Within_Cycle =
            dplyr::row_number(),
          Selection_Order =
            nrow(selected) +
            dplyr::row_number(),
          Selection_Round = paste0(
            "Chronological distinct-S_t selection cycle ",
            selection_cycle
          ),
          Calibration_Source =
            dplyr::if_else(
              In_D_3A,
              "D_3A",
              "D_Aug,S(d)"
            )
        )

      selected <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        selected,
        cycle_selected
      )

      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 8.4
      #
      # Remove only the selected events. Do not remove all events
      # having the same S_t values, because those values may recur
      # through different events in a later selection cycle.
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      remaining_candidates <- remaining_candidates |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !(Event_index %in%
              cycle_selected$Event_index)
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(
          Event_index
        )

      selection_cycle_summary_list[[
        selection_cycle
      ]] <- tibble::tibble(
        d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key =
          cluster_key_j,
        Selection_Cycle =
          selection_cycle,
        n_events_available_at_cycle_start =
          nrow(remaining_candidates) +
          nrow(cycle_selected),
        n_events_needed_at_cycle_start =
          n_needed,
        n_events_selected_in_cycle =
          nrow(cycle_selected),
        n_distinct_S_t_selected_in_cycle =
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            cycle_selected$S_t_distinct_key,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
        n_events_selected_cumulatively =
          nrow(selected),
        n_distinct_S_t_selected_cumulatively =
          dplyr::n_distinct(
            selected$S_t_distinct_key,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
        n_events_remaining_after_cycle =
          nrow(remaining_candidates),
        selected_event_index_in_cycle =
          paste(
            cycle_selected$Event_index,
            collapse = ", "
          ),
        selected_event_ids_in_cycle =
          paste(
            cycle_selected$Event,
            collapse = ", "
          ),
        selected_S_t_keys_in_cycle =
          paste(
            cycle_selected$S_t_distinct_key,
            collapse = ", "
          )
      )

      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 8.3
      #
      # Stop when n3A events have been selected. Step 9 will
      # determine whether these n3A events represent n3A distinct
      # S_t values and will classify the cluster accordingly.
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      if (nrow(selected) >= n_stage3A_events) {
        break
      }

      # --------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 8.5
      #
      # If no unselected event remains, retain the currently
      # available D_Cal,S,j(d) and terminate Step 8.
      # Otherwise, begin the next selection cycle.
      # --------------------------------------------------------

      if (nrow(remaining_candidates) == 0) {
        break
      }
    }

    selected <- selected |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        Selection_Order
      )

    selection_cycle_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      selection_cycle_summary_list
    )

    if (
      is.null(selection_cycle_summary) ||nrow(selection_cycle_summary) == 0) {
      selection_cycle_summary <- tibble::tibble()
    }

    list(
      selected_index =        selected$Event_index,
      selected_ids =        selected$Event,
      selection_detail =        selected,
      selection_cycle_summary =        selection_cycle_summary,
      n_selection_cycles =        selection_cycle,
      cluster_events_exhausted =    nrow(remaining_candidates) == 0
    )
  }

  cluster_selection_list <- lapply(
    selected_cluster_keys,
    select_cluster_calibration_events
  )

  names(cluster_selection_list) <-  selected_cluster_keys

  D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster <- lapply(
    cluster_selection_list,
    function(x) {
      x$selected_index
    }
  )

  D_Cal_S_event_ids_by_cluster <- lapply(
    cluster_selection_list,
    function(x) {
      x$selected_ids
    }
  )

  D_Cal_S_event_index <- sort(
    unique(
      unlist(
        D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster,
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  )

  if (length(D_Cal_S_event_index) == 0) {
    stop(
      "D_Cal,S(d) is empty. Bootstrap limits cannot be estimated."
    )
  }

  D_Cal_S_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(
      D_Cal_S_event_index,
      event_statistics$Event_index
    )
  ]

  cluster_selection_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_along(cluster_selection_list),
      function(ii) {

        detail_i <-
          cluster_selection_list[[ii]]$selection_detail

        if (
          is.null(detail_i) ||
          nrow(detail_i) == 0
        ) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        detail_i |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            selected_cluster_key =
              names(cluster_selection_list)[ii],
            selected_cluster_rank =
              ii
          )
      }
    )
  )

  if (
    is.null(cluster_selection_detail) ||
    nrow(cluster_selection_detail) == 0
  ) {
    cluster_selection_detail <- tibble::tibble()
  }

  cluster_selection_cycle_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_along(cluster_selection_list),
      function(ii) {

        summary_i <-
          cluster_selection_list[[
            ii
          ]]$selection_cycle_summary

        if (
          is.null(summary_i) || nrow(summary_i) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        summary_i |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            selected_cluster_key =
              names(cluster_selection_list)[ii],
            selected_cluster_rank =
              ii
          )
      }
    )
  )

  if (
    is.null(cluster_selection_cycle_summary) ||
    nrow(cluster_selection_cycle_summary) == 0
  ) {
    cluster_selection_cycle_summary <-tibble::tibble()
  }

  D_Aug_S_event_index <- sort(
    setdiff(
      D_Cal_S_event_index,
      D_3A_event_index
    )
  )

  D_Aug_S_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(
      D_Aug_S_event_index,
      event_statistics$Event_index
    )
  ]

  n_Cal <- length(
    D_Cal_S_event_index
  )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 9. Classify calibration status
  #
  # Step 8 has already constructed each D_Cal,S,j(d). Step 9
  # does not add, remove, or replace calibration events.
  #
  # Step 8 can produce three forms of the cluster-specific
  # calibration dataset, which are mapped into two statuses:
  #
  # 1. n_Cal_j = n3A and n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j = n3A:
  #    Calibration complete.
  #
  # 2. n_Cal_j = n3A and n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j < n3A:
  #    Calibration limited. Some S_t values recur across
  #    different selection cycles.
  #
  # 3. n_Cal_j < n3A and n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j < n3A:
  #    Calibration limited. All currently available eligible
  #    events have been exhausted before n3A events can be
  #    selected.
  #
  # Thus, formal calibration status is determined by the number
  # of distinct S_t values represented in D_Cal,S,j(d).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cluster_calibration_status <-
    selected_cluster_summary |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_j =
        n_events_cluster,

      n_Cal_j = length(
        D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster[[
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ]]
      ),

      n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j =
        dplyr::n_distinct(
          event_statistics$S_t_distinct_key[
            event_statistics$Event_index %in%
              D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster[[
                d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
              ]]
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      n_repeated_S_t_events_j =
        n_Cal_j -
        n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j,

      n_selection_cycles_j =
        cluster_selection_list[[
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ]]$n_selection_cycles,

      cluster_events_exhausted_j =
        cluster_selection_list[[
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ]]$cluster_events_exhausted,

      n_Aug_j = sum(
        D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster[[
          d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key
        ]] %in%
          D_Aug_S_event_index
      ),

      calibration_complete_j =
        n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j ==
        n_stage3A_events,

      calibration_limited_j =
        n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j <
        n_stage3A_events,

      calibration_status_j =
        dplyr::if_else(
          calibration_complete_j,
          "Calibration complete",
          "Calibration limited"
        ),

      calibration_dataset_form_j =
        dplyr::case_when(
          n_Cal_j == n_stage3A_events &&
            n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j ==
              n_stage3A_events ~
            paste0(
              "n3A events representing n3A ",
              "distinct S_t values"
            ),

          n_Cal_j == n_stage3A_events &&
            n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j <
              n_stage3A_events ~
            paste0(
              "n3A events representing fewer than ",
              "n3A distinct S_t values"
            ),

          n_Cal_j < n_stage3A_events ~
            paste0(
              "Fewer than n3A events after exhausting ",
              "currently available eligible events"
            ),

          TRUE ~
            "Unclassified calibration-dataset form"
        ),

      calibration_status_reason_j =
        dplyr::case_when(
          calibration_complete_j ~
            paste0(
              "The cluster-specific calibration dataset ",
              "contains ",
              n_stage3A_events,
              " events representing ",
              n_stage3A_events,
              " distinct S_t values."
            ),

          n_Cal_j == n_stage3A_events &&
            n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j <
              n_stage3A_events ~
            paste0(
              "The cluster-specific calibration dataset ",
              "contains ",
              n_stage3A_events,
              " events but only ",
              n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j,
              " distinct S_t values because one or more ",
              "S_t values recur across different selection ",
              "cycles."
            ),

          n_Cal_j < n_stage3A_events ~
            paste0(
              "The cluster-specific calibration dataset ",
              "contains only ",
              n_Cal_j,
              " events representing ",
              n_distinct_S_t_Cal_j,
              " distinct S_t values after all currently ",
              "available calibration-eligible events in ",
              "the cluster have been exhausted."
            ),

          TRUE ~
            "Calibration status could not be explained."
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  
  all_selected_clusters_complete <- all(
    cluster_calibration_status$calibration_complete_j
  )

  any_selected_cluster_limited <- any(
    cluster_calibration_status$calibration_limited_j
  )

  case_label <- NA_character_
  case_name <- NA_character_
  case_definition <- NA_character_
  calibration_finalized <- FALSE

  if (x == n_stage3A_events &&
      all_selected_clusters_complete) {

    case_label <- "Case 1"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Complete"

    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and every selected ordered cluster is ",
      "calibration-complete. The scale-calibration dataset ",
      "is finalized using the available events."
    )

    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (
    x == n_stage3A_events &&
    any_selected_cluster_limited
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 2"
    case_name <- "Initial Stage 3A Calibration Limited"

    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x = n3A and at least one selected ordered cluster is ",
      "calibration-limited. No post-Stage 3A events are ",
      "available, so the calibration dataset remains provisional."
    )

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
    all_selected_clusters_complete &&
    length(D_Aug_S_event_index) == 0
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 3"

    case_name <- paste0(
      "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized Without ",
      "Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    )

    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, every selected ordered cluster is ",
      "calibration-complete, and D_Aug,S(d) is empty. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset is finalized without ",
      "post-Stage 3A supplementation."
    )

    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
    all_selected_clusters_complete &&
    length(D_Aug_S_event_index) > 0
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 4"

    case_name <- paste0(
      "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Finalized With ",
      "Post-Stage 3A Supplementation"
    )

    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A, every selected ordered cluster is ",
      "calibration-complete, and D_Aug,S(d) is nonempty. ",
      "The scale-calibration dataset is finalized after ",
      "chronological post-Stage 3A supplementation."
    )

    calibration_finalized <- TRUE

  } else if (
    x > n_stage3A_events &&
    any_selected_cluster_limited
  ) {

    case_label <- "Case 5"

    case_name <- paste0(
      "Stage 3B Available, Calibration Still Provisional"
    )

    case_definition <- paste0(
      "x > n3A and at least one selected ordered cluster ",
      "remains calibration-limited after exhausting all ",
      "currently available eligible events from that cluster."
    )
  }

  if (is.na(case_label)) {
    stop(
      "The calibration case could not be classified."
    )
  }

  if (case_label == "Case 3") {

    monitoring_event_index <-
      D_3B_event_index

  } else if (case_label == "Case 4") {

    monitoring_event_index <- sort(
      setdiff(
        D_3B_event_index,
        D_Aug_S_event_index
      )
    )

  } else {

    monitoring_event_index <- integer(0)
  }

  monitoring_event_ids <- event_statistics$Event[
    match(
      monitoring_event_index,
      event_statistics$Event_index
    )
  ]

  event_statistics <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration =
        Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_augmented_calibration =
        Event_index %in% D_Aug_S_event_index,
      Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring =
        Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index
    )

  limits_estimated <- TRUE
  limits_finalized <- calibration_finalized

  limit_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    case_label == "Case 1" ~
      paste0(
        "Finalized d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated ",
        "from the initial Stage 3A calibration dataset."
      ),
    case_label == "Case 2" ~
      paste0(
        "Provisional d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated ",
        "from the currently available calibration dataset. ",
        "Routine Stage 3B monitoring has not begun."
      ),
    case_label == "Case 3" ~
      paste0(
        "Finalized d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated ",
        "without post-Stage 3A supplementation."
      ),
    case_label == "Case 4" ~
      paste0(
        "Finalized d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated ",
        "after chronological post-Stage 3A supplementation."
      ),
    case_label == "Case 5" ~
      paste0(
        "Provisional d-CCSSBU-S bootstrap limits estimated ",
        "from the currently available calibration dataset. ",
        "Only calibration-limited clusters remain open."
      ),
    TRUE ~
      "Unclassified limit status."
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Steps 10-13. Bootstrap calibration
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  calibrate_d_ccssbu_s_bootstrap <- function(
      calibration_event_index,
      seed_internal) {

    set.seed(seed_internal)

    calibration_data <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        Event_index %in%
          calibration_event_index
      )

    if (nrow(calibration_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No calibration data are available for bootstrap."
      )
    }

    loc_data <- split(
      calibration_data,
      calibration_data$Location
    )

    loc_data <- loc_data[
      vapply(
        loc_data,
        function(dloc) {
          any(
            !is.na(dloc$Normalized) &
              is.finite(dloc$Normalized)
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (length(loc_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No valid sampling-location strata are available."
      )
    }

    loc_data <- loc_data[sort(names(loc_data))]

    h_values <- vapply(
      loc_data,
      function(dloc) {
        z <- dloc$Normalized
        z <- z[!is.na(z) &is.finite(z)]
        h_raw <-c_smooth * mad_unscaled(z)
        if (!is.finite(h_raw)) {h_raw <- 0}
        max(  h_raw,  h_min )
      },
      numeric(1)
    )

    n_bootstrap_locations <-  length(loc_data)

    boot_mat <- matrix( NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = n_bootstrap_locations, dimnames = list(NULL, names(loc_data)))

    for (rr in seq_len(n_bootstrap_locations)) {

      z_r <- loc_data[[rr]]$Normalized
      z_r <- z_r[!is.na(z_r) &is.finite(z_r)]
      sampled_value <- sample(z_r,size = B, replace = TRUE)
      h_r <- h_values[rr]
      eps <- if (h_r == 0) {numeric(B)} else {stats::rnorm(B,mean = 0,sd = h_r)}
      boot_mat[, rr] <- pmax(0,sampled_value + eps)
    }

    if (n_bootstrap_locations == 1) {S_boot <- rep(0,B)} else {

      row_medians <- matrixStats::rowMedians(boot_mat,na.rm = TRUE)

      S_boot <- matrixStats::rowMedians(
        abs(
          sweep(
            boot_mat,
            1,
            row_medians,
            "-"
          )
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }

    CL_boot <- median(S_boot, na.rm = TRUE)

    UCL_boot <- fast_quantile(
      S_boot,
      1 - alpha
    )

    empirical_p0 <- mean(
      S_boot > UCL_boot,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    empirical_ARL0 <- if (
      empirical_p0 > 0
    ) {
      1 / empirical_p0
    } else {
      Inf
    }

    bootstrap_strata_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(
        names(loc_data),
        function(loc_name) {

          z <- loc_data[[loc_name]]$Normalized

          z <- z[
            !is.na(z) &
              is.finite(z)
          ]

          data.frame(
            Location = loc_name,
            n = length(z),
            median = median(z),
            MAD = mad_unscaled(z),
            h = unname(
              h_values[loc_name]
            ),
            min = min(z),
            max = max(z)
          )
        }
      )
    )

    list(
      calibration_data =        calibration_data,
      bootstrap_strata_summary =        bootstrap_strata_summary,
      bootstrap_h_values =        h_values,
      bootstrap_scale_matrix =
        if (return_bootstrap_matrix) {
          boot_mat
        } else {
          NULL
        },
      S_d_ccssbu_s_boot =
        if (keep_bootstrap_statistics) {
          S_boot
        } else {
          NULL
        },
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        CL_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        UCL_boot,
      empirical_p0_from_bootstrap =        empirical_p0,
      empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap =        empirical_ARL0,
      n_bootstrap_locations =        n_bootstrap_locations,
      bootstrap_location_names =        names(loc_data)
    )
  }

  boot_obj <- calibrate_d_ccssbu_s_bootstrap(
    calibration_event_index =      D_Cal_S_event_index,
    seed_internal =      seed + 1
  )

  calibration_data <-    boot_obj$calibration_data
  bootstrap_strata_summary <-    boot_obj$bootstrap_strata_summary
  bootstrap_h_values <-    boot_obj$bootstrap_h_values
  bootstrap_scale_matrix <-    boot_obj$bootstrap_scale_matrix
  bootstrap_statistics <-    boot_obj$S_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <-    boot_obj$CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot <-    boot_obj$UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
  empirical_p0_from_bootstrap <-    boot_obj$empirical_p0_from_bootstrap
  empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap <-    boot_obj$empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap
  bootstrap_location_names <-    boot_obj$bootstrap_location_names
  CL_obs <- median(event_statistics$S_t,na.rm = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Steps 14-15. Construct chart and classify monitoring
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_data <- event_statistics |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      CL_obs =        CL_obs,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S =  S_t > UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_S =Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring &Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
      Stage_Status = dplyr::case_when(
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_augmented_calibration ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event used only for scale calibration",
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_calibration & In_D_3A ~
          "Nominal Stage 3A event used for scale calibration",
        In_D_3A & !Scale_Calibration_Eligible ~
          paste0(
            "Nominal Stage 3A event excluded from calibration ",
            "because it contains an OOS observation"
          ),
        In_D_3A ~
          paste0(
            "Nominal Stage 3A event not contained in a ",
            "selected ordered cluster"
          ),
        Used_for_d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring ~
          "Routine Stage 3B monitoring event",
        In_D_3B &
          case_label %in% c("Case 2", "Case 5") ~
          paste0(
            "Post-Stage 3A event observed while calibration ",
            "remains provisional"
          ),
        In_D_3B ~
          "Post-Stage 3A event excluded from current monitoring",
        TRUE ~
          "Unclassified event"
      ),
      Limit_Status =      limit_status,
      OOC_Event_Label =
        dplyr::if_else(
          Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
          paste0("OOC:", Event),
          NA_character_
        ),
      Monitoring_OOC_Event_Label =
        dplyr::if_else(
          Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_S,
          paste0("OOC:", Event),
          NA_character_
        )
    )

  ooc_events <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index
    )

  monitoring_ooc_events <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Monitoring_Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Event_index
    )

  n_ooc_events <- nrow(
    ooc_events
  )

  n_stage3A_ooc <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      In_D_3A,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
    ) |>
    nrow()

  n_stage3B_ooc <- nrow(
    monitoring_ooc_events
  )

  n_ND_ooc <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      all_normalized_values_identical,
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
    ) |>
    nrow()

  stage3B_ooc_labels <-
    monitoring_ooc_events$Monitoring_OOC_Event_Label

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  chart_title <- paste0(
    "d-CCSSBU-S for ",
    safe_plot_text(residue_type),
    " of ",
    safe_plot_text(equipment_label)
  )

  chart_subtitle <- stringr::str_wrap(
    paste0(
      case_label,
      " | d=", d, "/", q,
      " | nCal=", n_Cal,
      " | UCLboot=",
      signif(UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4),
      " | CLboot=",
      signif(CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot, 4)
    ),
    width = 120
  )

  chart_caption <- stringr::str_wrap(
    paste0(
      "Stage 3A points above UCL = ",
      n_stage3A_ooc,
      "; routine Stage 3B OOC = ",
      n_stage3B_ooc,
      "; nCal = ", n_Cal,
      "; d = ", d, "/", q,
      "; ",
      ifelse(
        limits_finalized,
        "Finalized limits",
        "Provisional limits"
      )
    ),
    width = 100
  )

  y_values <- c(
    chart_data$S_t,
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
    CL_obs
  )

  y_max_plot <- max(
    y_values[
      is.finite(y_values)
    ]
  )

  y_upper_plot <- if (
    y_max_plot <= 0
  ) {
    1
  } else {
    y_max_plot * 1.30
  }

  x_min_plot <- min(
    chart_data$Event_index
  )

  x_max_plot <- max(
    chart_data$Event_index
  )

  x_range_plot <- max(
    1,
    x_max_plot - x_min_plot
  )

  x_label_pos <-
    x_max_plot + 0.025 * x_range_plot

  label_gap <-
    0.028 * y_upper_plot

  ucl_label_y <- min(
    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot +
      0.022 * y_upper_plot,
    0.985 * y_upper_plot
  )

  cl_boot_label_y <- min(
    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot + label_gap,
    0.94 * y_upper_plot
  )

  cl_obs_label_y <- max(
    CL_obs - label_gap,
    0.02 * y_upper_plot
  )

  if (
    abs(
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot - CL_obs
    ) < 2 * label_gap
  ) {

    cl_boot_label_y <- min(
      max(
        CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
        CL_obs
      ) + 1.3 * label_gap,
      0.94 * y_upper_plot
    )

    cl_obs_label_y <- max(
      min(
        CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
        CL_obs
      ) - 1.3 * label_gap,
      0.02 * y_upper_plot
    )
  }

  ooc_plot_data <- chart_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      OOC_Label_Y =
        pmax(
          S_t,
          UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot
        ) + 0.025 * y_upper_plot
    )

  plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    chart_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Event_index,
      y = S_t,
      group = 1
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = Signal_d_CCSSBU_S
      ),
      size = 0.42
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = ooc_plot_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = Event_index,
        y = OOC_Label_Y,
        label = OOC_Event_Label
      ),
      color = "red",
      hjust = -0.05,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 2.05,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        CL_obs,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "grey35",
      linewidth = 0.50
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = ucl_label_y,
      label = paste0(
        "UCLboot = ",
        signif(
          UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
          4
        )
      ),
      color = "red",
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.15
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = cl_boot_label_y,
      label = paste0(
        "CLboot = ",
        signif(
          CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
          4
        )
      ),
      color = "blue",
      hjust = 0,
      size = 1.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_label_pos,
      y = cl_obs_label_y,
      label = paste0(
        "CLobs = ",
        signif(CL_obs, 4)
      ),
      color = "grey35",
      hjust = 0,
      size = 1.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "FALSE" = "black",
        "TRUE" = "red"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "FALSE" = "In control",
        "TRUE" = "Candidate OOC"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        0,
        y_upper_plot
      ),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(
        mult = c(
          0.02,
          0.08
        )
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off",
      xlim = c(
        x_min_plot,
        x_max_plot +
          0.08 * x_range_plot
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = chart_title,
      subtitle = chart_subtitle,
      caption = chart_caption,
      x = "Cleaning Event",
      y = expression(S[t]),
      color = "Signal"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 10,
          face = "bold"
        ),
      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 6.5
        ),
      plot.caption =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 5.8,
          hjust = 0
        ),
      plot.margin =
        ggplot2::margin(
          8,
          75,
          8,
          8
        ),
      legend.position =
        "bottom",
      axis.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8.2
        ),
      axis.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 6.8
        )
    )

  if (x > n_stage3A_events) {

    boundary_x <-
      n_stage3A_events + 0.5

    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = boundary_x,
        linetype = "dotdash",
        color = "darkgreen",
        linewidth = 0.65
      )
  }

  if (length(D_Aug_S_event_index) > 0) {

    plot_obj <- plot_obj +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = chart_data |>
          dplyr::filter(
            Event_index %in%
              D_Aug_S_event_index
          ),
        ggplot2::aes(
          x = Event_index,
          y = S_t
        ),
        shape = 21,
        fill = "orange",
        color = "black",
        size = 0.90,
        stroke = 0.25
      )
  }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output tables and files
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  calibration_event_check <-
    cluster_selection_detail |>
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::everything()
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_CCSSBU_S_Calibration_Role =
        dplyr::case_when(
          Calibration_Source == "D_3A" ~
            paste0(
              "Nominal Stage 3A calibration event selected ",
              "chronologically in selection cycle ",
              Selection_Cycle,
              " with an S_t value distinct within that cycle"
            ),

          Calibration_Source == "D_Aug,S(d)" ~
            paste0(
              "Post-Stage 3A calibration event selected ",
              "chronologically in selection cycle ",
              Selection_Cycle,
              " with an S_t value distinct within that cycle"
            ),

          TRUE ~
            paste0(
              "Calibration event selected chronologically ",
              "with an S_t value distinct within its ",
              "selection cycle"
            )
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      selected_cluster_rank,
      Selection_Order
    )
  
  safe_equipment <- safe_name(
    equipment_label
  )

  safe_residue <- safe_name(
    residue_type
  )

  safe_cluster <- safe_name(
    cluster_col
  )

  safe_c <- gsub(
    "\\.",
    "p",
    as.character(c_smooth)
  )

  safe_hmin <- gsub(
    "\\.",
    "p",
    as.character(h_min)
  )

  safe_thresh <- gsub(
    "\\.",
    "p",
    as.character(
      scale_eligibility_threshold
    )
  )

  file_stub <- paste0(
    "d_CCSSBU_S_",
    safe_residue,
    "_",
    safe_equipment,
    "_cluster_",
    safe_cluster,
    "_d_",
    d,
    "_ARL0_",
    target_ARL0,
    "_c_",
    safe_c,
    "_hmin_",
    safe_hmin,
    "_elig_",
    safe_thresh
  )

  chart_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      ".png"
    )
  )

  event_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_event_statistics.csv"
    )
  )

  normalized_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_normalized_data.csv"
    )
  )

  cluster_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_ordered_cluster_summary.csv"
    )
  )

  calibration_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_calibration_events.csv"
    )
  )

  cluster_selection_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_cluster_selection_detail.csv"
    )
  )
  
  cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_cluster_selection_cycle_summary.csv"
    )
  )

  cluster_status_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_cluster_calibration_status.csv"
    )
  )

  bootstrap_strata_csv_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_bootstrap_strata_summary.csv"
    )
  )

  rds_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      file_stub,
      "_fit.rds"
    )
  )

  if (save_outputs) {

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = chart_file,
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = 11,
      height = 6.2,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300,
      bg = "white"
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      chart_data,
      event_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      normalized_data,
      normalized_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      cluster_summary,
      cluster_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      calibration_event_check,
      calibration_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      cluster_selection_detail,
      cluster_selection_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      cluster_calibration_status,
      cluster_status_csv_file
    )

    readr::write_csv(
      bootstrap_strata_summary,
      bootstrap_strata_csv_file
    )
    
    readr::write_csv(
      cluster_selection_cycle_summary,
      cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file
    )
  }

  files <- list(
    chart_file =if (save_outputs) chart_file else NA_character_,
    event_statistics_csv =if (save_outputs) event_csv_file else NA_character_,
    normalized_data_csv = if (save_outputs) normalized_csv_file else NA_character_,
    ordered_cluster_summary_csv =if (save_outputs) cluster_csv_file else NA_character_,
    calibration_events_csv =if (save_outputs) calibration_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_detail_csv =if (save_outputs) cluster_selection_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_calibration_status_csv =if (save_outputs) cluster_status_csv_file else NA_character_,
    bootstrap_strata_summary_csv =if (save_outputs) bootstrap_strata_csv_file else NA_character_,
    cluster_selection_cycle_summary_csv = if (save_outputs) {cluster_selection_cycle_csv_file} else {NA_character_},
    rds_file =if (save_outputs) rds_file else NA_character_
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reusable output object
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  result <- list(
    method = "d-CCSSBU-S",
    chart_family = "CCSSBU",
    chart_statistic = "Scale",
    function_name = "d_ccssbu_s",
    call = match.call(),

    file = file,
    equipment_label = equipment_label,
    residue_type = residue_type,
    sheet = sheet,

    analysis_stage = analysis_stage,
    case_label = case_label,
    case_name = case_name,
    case_definition = case_definition,
    calibration_finalized = calibration_finalized,
    limits_estimated = limits_estimated,
    limits_finalized = limits_finalized,
    limit_status = limit_status,

    d = d,
    q = q,
    selected_ordered_cluster_ranks = seq_len(d),
    selected_cluster_keys = selected_cluster_keys,
    cluster_col = cluster_col,
    cluster_group_cols = cluster_group_cols,
    cluster_round_digits = cluster_round_digits,
    n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
    n_total_events = x,
    target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
    alpha = alpha,
    B = B,
    c_smooth = c_smooth,
    h_min = h_min,
    seed = seed,
    scale_eligibility_threshold =      scale_eligibility_threshold,
    scale_distinct_digits =      scale_distinct_digits,

    D_3A_event_index =      D_3A_event_index,
    D_3A_event_ids =      D_3A_event_ids,
    D_3B_event_index =      D_3B_event_index,
    D_3B_event_ids =      D_3B_event_ids,

    D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster =      D_Cal_S_event_index_by_cluster,
    D_Cal_S_event_ids_by_cluster =      D_Cal_S_event_ids_by_cluster,
    n_selection_cycles_by_cluster = stats::setNames(
        vapply(cluster_selection_list,function(x) {x$n_selection_cycles},integer(1)),
        names(cluster_selection_list)
      ),

    cluster_events_exhausted_by_cluster =stats::setNames(
        vapply(cluster_selection_list, function(x) {x$cluster_events_exhausted},logical(1)),
        names(cluster_selection_list)),
    
    D_Cal_S_event_index =      D_Cal_S_event_index,
    D_Cal_S_event_ids =      D_Cal_S_event_ids,
    D_Aug_S_event_index =      D_Aug_S_event_index,
    D_Aug_S_event_ids =      D_Aug_S_event_ids,
    monitoring_event_index =      monitoring_event_index,
    monitoring_event_ids =      monitoring_event_ids,
    n_Cal = n_Cal,

    all_selected_clusters_complete =      all_selected_clusters_complete,
    any_selected_cluster_limited =      any_selected_cluster_limited,

    normalized_data =      normalized_data,
    event_statistics =      chart_data,
    event_statistics_eligible =      event_statistics_eligible,
    cluster_summary =      cluster_summary,
    selected_cluster_summary =      selected_cluster_summary,
    stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary =      stage3A_ordered_cluster_summary,
    cluster_selection_detail =      cluster_selection_detail,
    cluster_selection_cycle_summary = cluster_selection_cycle_summary,
    cluster_calibration_status =cluster_calibration_status,
    calibration_data =  calibration_data,
    calibration_event_check =      calibration_event_check,
    bootstrap_strata_summary =      bootstrap_strata_summary,

    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,

    CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot_definition =      paste0(
        "Bootstrap center line: median of S_boot ",
        "estimated from D_Cal,S(d)."
      ),

    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,

    UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot_definition =      paste0(
        "Bootstrap upper control limit: empirical ",
        "1-alpha quantile of S_boot estimated from D_Cal,S(d)."
      ),

    CL_obs =      CL_obs,

    CL_obs_definition =      paste0(
        "Observed descriptive center line: median of all ",
        "observed S_t values. It is not the monitoring limit."
      ),

    bootstrap_statistics_S =      bootstrap_statistics,
    bootstrap_scale_matrix =      bootstrap_scale_matrix,
    bootstrap_h_values =      bootstrap_h_values,
    bootstrap_location_names =      bootstrap_location_names,
    empirical_p0_from_bootstrap =      empirical_p0_from_bootstrap,
    empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap =      empirical_ARL0_from_bootstrap,

    ooc_events =      ooc_events,
    monitoring_ooc_events =      monitoring_ooc_events,
    n_ooc_events =      n_ooc_events,
    n_stage3A_ooc =      n_stage3A_ooc,
    n_stage3B_ooc =      n_stage3B_ooc,
    n_ND_ooc =      n_ND_ooc,
    stage3B_ooc_labels =      stage3B_ooc_labels,

    reusable = list(
      all_event_index =        chart_data$Event_index,
      all_event_ids =        chart_data$Event,
      all_L_t =        chart_data$L_t,
      all_S_t =        chart_data$S_t,
      all_Max_Z_t =        chart_data$Max_Z_t,
      all_cluster_key =        chart_data$d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_key,
      all_scale_calibration_eligible =        chart_data$Scale_Calibration_Eligible,

      D_3A_event_index =        D_3A_event_index,
      D_3B_event_index =        D_3B_event_index,
      calibration_event_index =        D_Cal_S_event_index,
      calibration_event_ids =        D_Cal_S_event_ids,

      calibration_L_t = chart_data$L_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index],

      calibration_S_t = chart_data$S_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% D_Cal_S_event_index],

      augmented_event_index = D_Aug_S_event_index,
      augmented_event_ids = D_Aug_S_event_ids,

      monitoring_event_index = monitoring_event_index,
      monitoring_event_ids =monitoring_event_ids,

      monitoring_L_t =chart_data$L_t[chart_data$Event_index %in%  monitoring_event_index],

      monitoring_S_t = chart_data$S_t[chart_data$Event_index %in% monitoring_event_index],

      bootstrap_S_t =        bootstrap_statistics,
      CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,
      UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot =        UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot,

      limits_estimated =        limits_estimated,
      limits_finalized =        limits_finalized,
      limit_status =        limit_status,

      alpha =        alpha,
      target_ARL0 =        target_ARL0,
      B =        B,
      c_smooth =        c_smooth,
      h_min =        h_min,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =        scale_eligibility_threshold
    ),

    d_CCSSBU_S_cluster_rule = paste0(
      "Clusters are defined by residue type and ",
      cluster_col,
      ". An event is calibration-eligible when Max_Z_t <= ",
      scale_eligibility_threshold,
      ". If a cluster contains eligible nominal Stage 3A ",
      "events, its ordering statistic is the median S_t ",
      "from those events. Otherwise, it is calculated from ",
      "all currently available eligible events."
    ),
    
        d_CCSSBU_S_calibration_rule = paste0(
      "For each of the first d ordered DAR clusters, ",
      "D_Cal,S,j(d) is initialized as the empty set. ",
      "The currently available calibration-eligible events ",
      "from the cluster are processed chronologically through ",
      "one or more selection cycles. Within each cycle, at most ",
      "one event is selected for each distinct S_t value, where ",
      "operational distinctness is determined after rounding ",
      "S_t to ",
      scale_distinct_digits,
      " decimal places. Only the selected events are removed ",
      "before the next cycle. Therefore, an S_t value selected ",
      "in an earlier cycle may recur through a different event ",
      "in a later cycle. Selection terminates when n3A events ",
      "have been selected or all currently available eligible ",
      "events in the cluster have been exhausted. A cluster is ",
      "calibration-complete only when its selected calibration ",
      "events represent n3A distinct S_t values. Otherwise, it ",
      "is calibration-limited. A calibration-complete cluster ",
      "is frozen for the current calibration cycle. A ",
      "calibration-limited cluster is reconstructed from all ",
      "currently available eligible events when additional ",
      "eligible observations from that cluster become available."
    ),
    
    d_CCSSBU_S_limit_rule = paste0(
      "Bootstrap limits are estimated from the current ",
      "D_Cal,S(d). Under Cases 1, 3, and 4, the calibration ",
      "dataset and limits are finalized. Under Cases 2 and 5, ",
      "only calibration-limited clusters remain open."
    ),

    d_CCSSBU_S_monitoring_rule = paste0(
      "Under Case 3, all D3B events are monitoring events. ",
      "Under Case 4, events in D_Aug,S(d) are used only for ",
      "calibration and excluded from monitoring. Under Cases ",
      "2 and 5, routine Stage 3B monitoring has not begun."
    ),

    chart_title =
      chart_title,
    chart_subtitle =
      chart_subtitle,
    chart_caption =
      chart_caption,
    chart =
      plot_obj,
    files =
      files
  )

  class(result) <- c(
    "d_ccssbu_s",
    "ccssbu_s",
    "list"
  )

  if (save_outputs) {
    saveRDS(
      object = result,
      file = rds_file
    )
  }

  if (plot_chart) {
    print(plot_obj)
  }

  return(result)
}
```

```{r make-d-ccssbu-s-arl1-wide-tbl-function}
#| echo: false

make_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_wide_tbl <- function(tbl) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "case_label",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "UCL",
    "rho",
    "S_chart_ARL1",
    "ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  make_rho_label <- function(x) {

    x_formatted <- formatC(
      x,
      format = "f",
      digits = 2
    )

    gsub(
      pattern = "\\.",
      replacement = "p",
      x = x_formatted
    )
  }

  tbl_wide_input <- tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      rho_label = make_rho_label(rho)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Residue,
      d,
      q,
      case_label,
      nCal,
      OOC_ND,
      OOC_3A,
      OOC_3B,
      benchmark_n,
      UCL,
      rho,
      rho_label,
      S_chart_ARL1,
      ARL1
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  duplicate_rows <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::count(
      Residue,
      d,
      rho_label,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  inconsistent_ids <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      d
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_q = dplyr::n_distinct(q),
      n_case_label = dplyr::n_distinct(case_label),
      n_nCal = dplyr::n_distinct(nCal),
      n_OOC_ND = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_ND),
      n_OOC_3A = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_3A),
      n_OOC_3B = dplyr::n_distinct(OOC_3B),
      n_benchmark_n = dplyr::n_distinct(benchmark_n),
      n_UCL = dplyr::n_distinct(UCL),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_q > 1 |
        n_case_label > 1 |
        n_nCal > 1 |
        n_OOC_ND > 1 |
        n_OOC_3A > 1 |
        n_OOC_3B > 1 |
        n_benchmark_n > 1 |
        n_UCL > 1
    )

  if (nrow(inconsistent_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "One or more d-specific columns vary across rho for ",
        "the same Residue and d combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_inconsistency <- tbl_wide_input |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      benchmark_n,
      rho_label
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(S_chart_ARL1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_inconsistency) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The S-chart ARL1 benchmark varies across d for at ",
        "least one Residue, benchmark_n, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  id_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "q",
    "case_label",
    "nCal",
    "OOC_ND",
    "OOC_3A",
    "OOC_3B",
    "benchmark_n",
    "UCL"
  )

  tbl_wide_input |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = dplyr::all_of(id_columns),
      names_from = rho_label,
      values_from = c(
        S_chart_ARL1,
        ARL1
      ),
      names_glue = "{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort = FALSE
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      Residue,
      d
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Residue,
      d,
      q,
      case_label,
      nCal,
      OOC_ND,
      OOC_3A,
      OOC_3B,
      benchmark_n,
      UCL,
      dplyr::starts_with("S_chart_ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::starts_with("ARL1_rho_"),
      dplyr::everything()
    )
}
```
