```{r d-ccssbu-s-d-selection-arl1-functions-v6}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1 <- function(
  file,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  residue_types = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  sheets = residue_types,
  n_stage3A_events = 10,
  target_ARL0 = 740,
  B = 20000,
  c_smooth = 0.5,
  h_min = 0.05,
  seed = 2026,
  scale_eligibility_threshold = 100,
  scale_distinct_digits = 10,
  cluster_col = "USL", # USL=API for our data and our API has alias
  cluster_group_cols = NULL,
  cluster_round_digits = 10,
  rho_grid = c( 1.05,  1.10,  1.20,   1.50,  2.00,2.25),
  T_max = 10000,
  benchmark_n = NULL,
  event_col = "Event",
  location_col = "Location",
  result_col = "Result",
  lod_col = "LOD",
  loq_col = "LOQ",
  usl_col = "USL",
  comparison_tolerance = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
  round_digits = 4,
  verbose = TRUE
) {
  required_packages <- c(  "dplyr",   "tibble",   "tidyr"  )
  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_packages,
        collapse = ", "  )) }

  if (!exists("d_ccssbu_s", mode = "function")) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The function d_ccssbu_s() must be defined before ",
        "running d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1()."
      ))}

  # Validate arguments


  if (length(residue_types) != length(sheets)) {
    stop(
      "residue_types and sheets must have the same length."
    )
  }

  if (length(residue_types) == 0) {
    stop(
      "At least one residue type must be supplied."
    )
  }

  residue_types <- as.character(
    residue_types
  )

  sheets <- as.character(
    sheets
  )

  if (
    anyNA(residue_types) ||
      any(!nzchar(trimws(residue_types)))
  ) {
    stop(
      "residue_types must contain nonempty character values."
    )
  }

  if (
    anyNA(sheets) ||
      any(!nzchar(trimws(sheets)))
  ) {
    stop(
      "sheets must contain nonempty character values."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(n_stage3A_events) != 1 ||
      is.na(n_stage3A_events) ||
      !is.finite(n_stage3A_events) ||
      n_stage3A_events < 1
  ) {
    stop(
      "n_stage3A_events must be a positive integer."
    )
  }

  n_stage3A_events <- as.integer(
    round(n_stage3A_events)
  )

  if (
    length(target_ARL0) != 1 ||
      is.na(target_ARL0) ||
      !is.finite(target_ARL0) ||
      target_ARL0 <= 1
  ) {
    stop(
      "target_ARL0 must be a finite number greater than 1."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(B) != 1 ||
      is.na(B) ||
      !is.finite(B) ||
      B <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "B must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  B <- as.integer(
    round(B)
  )

  if (
    length(c_smooth) != 1 ||
      is.na(c_smooth) ||
      !is.finite(c_smooth) ||
      c_smooth < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "c_smooth must be a finite nonnegative number."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(h_min) != 1 ||
      is.na(h_min) ||
      !is.finite(h_min) ||
      h_min <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "h_min must be a strictly positive finite number ",
        "for the benchmark model."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(scale_eligibility_threshold) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      !is.finite(scale_eligibility_threshold) ||
      scale_eligibility_threshold <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "scale_eligibility_threshold must be positive."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(scale_distinct_digits) != 1 ||
      is.na(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      !is.finite(scale_distinct_digits) ||
      scale_distinct_digits < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "scale_distinct_digits must be a nonnegative integer."
    )
  }

  scale_distinct_digits <- as.integer(
    round(scale_distinct_digits)
  )

  if (
    length(T_max) != 1 ||
      is.na(T_max) ||
      !is.finite(T_max) ||
      T_max <= 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "T_max must be a positive finite number."
    )
  }

  T_max <- as.numeric(
    T_max
  )

  if (
    length(comparison_tolerance) != 1 ||
      is.na(comparison_tolerance) ||
      !is.finite(comparison_tolerance) ||
      comparison_tolerance < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "comparison_tolerance must be a finite ",
        "nonnegative number."
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(round_digits) != 1 ||
      is.na(round_digits) ||
      !is.finite(round_digits) ||
      round_digits < 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "round_digits must be a finite nonnegative integer."
    )
  }

  round_digits <- as.integer(
    round(round_digits)
  )

  rho_grid <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(rho_grid)
  )

  if (
    length(rho_grid) == 0 ||
      anyNA(rho_grid) ||
      any(!is.finite(rho_grid)) ||
      any(rho_grid <= 1)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "rho_grid must contain finite numeric values greater ",
        "than 1. The in-control value rho = 1 is not included ",
        "in the OC curve-comparison grid."
      )
    )
  }

  rho_grid <- sort(
    unique(rho_grid)
  )

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0

  # ==========================================================
  # General helper functions
  # ==========================================================

  collapse_set <- function(x) {

    x <- sort(
      unique(x)
    )

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return("")
    }

    paste(
      x,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  }

  values_tied <- function(
    x,
    target,
    tolerance = comparison_tolerance
  ) {

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(
        logical(0)
      )
    }

    if (
      length(target) != 1 ||
        is.na(target)
    ) {
      return(
        rep(
          FALSE,
          length(x)
        )
      )
    }

    if (is.infinite(target)) {
      return(
        is.infinite(x) &
          sign(x) == sign(target)
      )
    }

    is.finite(x) &
      abs(x - target) <=
        tolerance * max(
          1,
          abs(target)
        )
  }

  make_rho_label <- function(x) {

    x <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x)
    )

    if (
      anyNA(x) ||
        any(!is.finite(x))
    ) {
      stop(
        "rho must contain only finite numeric values."
      )
    }

    x_formatted <- format(
      x,
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE,
      digits = 15
    )

    x_formatted <- sub(
      pattern = "0+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = x_formatted
    )

    x_formatted <- sub(
      pattern = "\\.$",
      replacement = "",
      x = x_formatted
    )

    gsub(
      pattern = "\\.",
      replacement = "p",
      x = x_formatted
    )
  }

  round_numeric_columns <- function(tbl) {

    numeric_columns <- names(tbl)[
      vapply(
        tbl,
        is.numeric,
        FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
      )
    ]

    tbl |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(
            numeric_columns
          ),
          ~ round(
            .x,
            digits = round_digits
          )
        )
      )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract and validate information returned by d_ccssbu_s()
  # ==========================================================

  extract_event_statistics <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    event_statistics <- fit$event_statistics

    if (
      is.null(event_statistics) ||
        !is.data.frame(event_statistics) ||
        nrow(event_statistics) == 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No nonempty event_statistics table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    required_columns <- c(
      "Event",
      "Event_index",
      "S_t",
      "n_locations_observed"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(event_statistics)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "event_statistics for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ": ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          ),
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::as_tibble(
      event_statistics
    )
  }

  extract_normalized_data <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    normalized_data <- fit$normalized_data

    if (
      is.null(normalized_data) ||
        !is.data.frame(normalized_data) ||
        nrow(normalized_data) == 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No nonempty normalized_data table was returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    required_columns <- c(
      "Event_index",
      "Normalized"
    )

    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(normalized_data)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following required column(s) are missing from ",
          "normalized_data for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ": ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          ),
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::as_tibble(
      normalized_data
    )
  }

  extract_q <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type
  ) {

    q_value <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(fit$q)
    )

    if (
      length(q_value) != 1 ||
        is.na(q_value) ||
        !is.finite(q_value) ||
        q_value < 1
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A valid q value was not returned by d_ccssbu_s() ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_integer <- as.integer(
      round(q_value)
    )

    if (
      abs(q_value - q_integer) >
        comparison_tolerance
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The q value returned by d_ccssbu_s() is not an ",
          "integer for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_integer
  }

  extract_stage3a_z <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type
  ) {

    normalized_data <- extract_normalized_data(
      fit = fit,
      residue_type = residue_type,
      d_value = 1
    )

    D_3A_event_index <- suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(
        fit$D_3A_event_index
      )
    )

    D_3A_event_index <- sort(
      unique(
        D_3A_event_index[
          !is.na(D_3A_event_index)
        ]
      )
    )

    if (length(D_3A_event_index) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No Stage 3A event indices were returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    stage3a_z <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Event_index %in%
          D_3A_event_index
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$Normalized
      )

    stage3a_z <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(stage3a_z)
    )

    stage3a_z <- stage3a_z[
      !is.na(stage3a_z) &
        is.finite(stage3a_z)
    ]

    if (length(stage3a_z) < 2) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least two finite Stage 3A USL-normalized ",
          "observations are required for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    stage3a_z
  }

  extract_bootstrap_scale <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    bootstrap_scale <- fit$bootstrap_statistics_S

    if (is.null(bootstrap_scale)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "bootstrap_statistics_S was not returned by ",
          "d_ccssbu_s() for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ". Run d_ccssbu_s() with ",
          "keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE."
        )
      )
    }

    bootstrap_scale <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(bootstrap_scale)
    )

    bootstrap_scale <- bootstrap_scale[
      !is.na(bootstrap_scale) &
        is.finite(bootstrap_scale)
    ]

    if (length(bootstrap_scale) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "No finite bootstrap scale statistics were found ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    bootstrap_scale
  }

  extract_chart_limit <- function(
    fit,
    limit_type,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    if (identical(limit_type, "CL")) {

      limit_value <- fit$CL_d_ccssbu_s_boot

    } else if (identical(limit_type, "UCL")) {

      limit_value <- fit$UCL_d_ccssbu_s_boot

    } else {

      stop(
        "limit_type must be either CL or UCL."
      )
    }

    limit_value <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(limit_value)
    )

    if (
      length(limit_value) != 1 ||
        is.na(limit_value) ||
        !is.finite(limit_value)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A finite ",
          limit_type,
          " was not returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    limit_value
  }

  extract_calibration_case <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    calibration_case <- as.character(
      fit$case_label
    )

    calibration_case <- calibration_case[
      !is.na(calibration_case) &
        nzchar(trimws(calibration_case))
    ]

    if (length(calibration_case) == 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "case_label was not returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    calibration_case[[1]]
  }

  extract_n_cal <- function(
    fit,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    n_cal <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(fit$n_Cal)
    )

    if (
      length(n_cal) != 1 ||
        is.na(n_cal) ||
        !is.finite(n_cal) ||
        n_cal < 1
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A valid n_Cal value was not returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    n_cal_integer <- as.integer(
      round(n_cal)
    )

    if (
      abs(n_cal - n_cal_integer) >
        comparison_tolerance
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "n_Cal is not an integer for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    n_cal_integer
  }

  validate_ooc_count <- function(
    value,
    value_name,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    value <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(value)
    )

    if (
      length(value) != 1 ||
        is.na(value) ||
        !is.finite(value) ||
        value < 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "A valid ",
          value_name,
          " was not returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    value_integer <- as.integer(
      round(value)
    )

    if (
      abs(value - value_integer) >
        comparison_tolerance
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          value_name,
          " is not an integer for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    value_integer
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Identify all-ND events
  # ==========================================================

  extract_all_nd_event_index <- function(
    fit,
    event_statistics,
    normalized_data,
    residue_type,
    d_value
  ) {

    if ("all_ND_event" %in% names(event_statistics)) {

      all_nd_event_index <- event_statistics |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(.data$all_ND_event),
          .data$all_ND_event
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$Event_index
        )

    } else if ("ND_flag" %in% names(normalized_data)) {

      all_nd_event_index <- normalized_data |>
        dplyr::group_by(
          .data$Event_index
        ) |>
        dplyr::summarise(
          all_ND_event = all(
            .data$ND_flag,
            na.rm = FALSE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(.data$all_ND_event),
          .data$all_ND_event
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$Event_index
        )

    } else {

      stop(
        paste0(
          "Neither all_ND_event in event_statistics nor ",
          "ND_flag in normalized_data was returned for residue ",
          residue_type,
          " and d = ",
          d_value,
          ". An all-ND event cannot be identified reliably."
        )
      )
    }

    sort(
      unique(
        suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(all_nd_event_index)
        )
      )
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Conventional normal-reference one-sided S-chart ARL1
  # ==========================================================

  conventional_s_chart_arl1 <- function(
    n,
    rho,
    alpha
  ) {

    if (
      length(n) != 1 ||
        is.na(n) ||
        !is.finite(n) ||
        n < 2
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (
      length(rho) != 1 ||
        is.na(rho) ||
        !is.finite(rho) ||
        rho <= 0
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (
      length(alpha) != 1 ||
        is.na(alpha) ||
        !is.finite(alpha) ||
        alpha <= 0 ||
        alpha >= 1
    ) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    n <- as.integer(
      round(n)
    )

    degrees_of_freedom <- n - 1L

    chi_square_limit <- stats::qchisq(
      p = 1 - alpha,
      df = degrees_of_freedom
    )

    chi_square_threshold <-
      chi_square_limit / rho^2

    p1_s <- stats::pchisq(
      q = chi_square_threshold,
      df = degrees_of_freedom,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )

    if (is.na(p1_s)) {
      return(
        NA_real_
      )
    }

    if (p1_s <= 0) {
      return(
        Inf
      )
    }

    1 / p1_s
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Determine conventional S-chart benchmark subgroup size
  # ==========================================================

  get_benchmark_n <- function(
    residue_type,
    residue_position,
    event_statistics
  ) {

    if (is.null(benchmark_n)) {

      if (
        !"n_locations_observed" %in%
          names(event_statistics)
      ) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "The column n_locations_observed was not found ",
            "for residue ",
            residue_type,
            ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
          )
        )
      }

      observed_n <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          event_statistics$n_locations_observed
        )
      )

      observed_n <- observed_n[
        !is.na(observed_n) &
          is.finite(observed_n) &
          observed_n >= 2
      ]

      if (length(observed_n) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No finite subgroup sizes of at least 2 were found ",
            "for residue ",
            residue_type,
            ". Provide benchmark_n explicitly."
          )
        )
      }

      benchmark_n_i <- as.integer(
        round(
          stats::median(observed_n)
        )
      )

    } else if (
      !is.null(names(benchmark_n)) &&
        residue_type %in% names(benchmark_n)
    ) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[residue_type]]
        )
      )

    } else if (length(benchmark_n) == 1) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[1]]
        )
      )

    } else if (
      length(benchmark_n) ==
        length(residue_types)
    ) {

      benchmark_n_i <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          benchmark_n[[residue_position]]
        )
      )

    } else {

      stop(
        paste0(
          "benchmark_n must be NULL, one number, a named ",
          "vector by residue type, or a vector having the ",
          "same length as residue_types."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      length(benchmark_n_i) != 1 ||
        is.na(benchmark_n_i) ||
        !is.finite(benchmark_n_i) ||
        benchmark_n_i < 2
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The conventional S-chart benchmark requires ",
          "benchmark_n >= 2 for residue ",
          residue_type,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    benchmark_n_i
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Recommend d for one residue type
  # ==========================================================

  recommend_d_for_residue <- function(
    candidate_tbl
  ) {
    required_columns <- c(
  "Residue",
  "d",
  "q",
  "OOC_ND",
  "OOC_3A",
  "OOC_3B",
  "rho",
  "ARL1",
  "S_chart_ARL1",
  "s_Z",
  "sigma_Z"
)
    
    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      required_columns,
      names(candidate_tbl)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The recommendation input is missing column(s): ",
          paste(
            missing_columns,
            collapse = ", "
          )
        )
      )
    }

    if (nrow(candidate_tbl) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No candidate rows were supplied."
      )
    }

    residue_values <- unique(
      as.character(
        candidate_tbl$Residue
      )
    )

    residue_values <- residue_values[
      !is.na(residue_values) &
        nzchar(trimws(residue_values))
    ]

    if (length(residue_values) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "recommend_d_for_residue() requires exactly one ",
          "residue type."
        )
      )
    }

    residue_i <- residue_values[[1]]

    q_values <- unique(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(candidate_tbl$q)
      )
    )

    q_values <- q_values[
      !is.na(q_values) &
        is.finite(q_values)
    ]

    if (length(q_values) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Exactly one finite q value is required for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    q_i <- as.integer(
      round(q_values[[1]])
    )

    candidate_values <- sort(
      unique(
        suppressWarnings(
          as.integer(candidate_tbl$d)
        )
      )
    )

    candidate_values <- candidate_values[
      !is.na(candidate_values)
    ]

    expected_candidates <- seq_len(
      q_i
    )

    if (!identical(
      candidate_values,
      expected_candidates
    )) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The candidate set for residue ",
          residue_i,
          " must be d = 1, 2, ..., q."
        )
      )
    }

    duplicate_grid_rows <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::count(
        .data$d,
        .data$rho,
        name = "n_rows"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$n_rows != 1
      )

    if (nrow(duplicate_grid_rows) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one residue-d-rho combination has ",
          "duplicate rows for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    for (d_i in candidate_values) {

      observed_rho_i <- candidate_tbl |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$d == d_i
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$rho
        )

      observed_rho_i <- sort(
        unique(
          suppressWarnings(
            as.numeric(observed_rho_i)
          )
        )
      )

      if (
        length(observed_rho_i) !=
          length(rho_grid) ||
          any(
            abs(
              observed_rho_i -
                rho_grid
            ) >
              comparison_tolerance
          )
      ) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Candidate d = ",
            d_i,
            " for residue ",
            residue_i,
            " does not contain the complete rho grid."
          )
        )
      }
    }

    candidate_identifier_check <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_OOC_ND = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_ND,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        n_OOC_3A = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3A,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        n_OOC_3B = dplyr::n_distinct(
          .data$OOC_3B,
          na.rm = FALSE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$n_OOC_ND > 1 |
          .data$n_OOC_3A > 1 |
          .data$n_OOC_3B > 1
      )

    if (nrow(candidate_identifier_check) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "OOC counts vary across rho for at least one d ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    candidate_metrics <- candidate_tbl |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        R =
          .data$ARL1 /
            .data$S_chart_ARL1
      ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$Residue,
        .data$d,
        .data$q
      ) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        OOC_ND =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_ND),
        OOC_3A =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3A),
        OOC_3B =
          dplyr::first(.data$OOC_3B),

        all_R_valid = all(
          !is.na(.data$R) &
            .data$R > 0
        ),

        W = if (
          all(
            !is.na(.data$R) &
              .data$R > 0
          )
        ) {
          max(.data$R)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },

        G = if (
          all(
            !is.na(.data$R) &
              .data$R > 0
          )
        ) {
          exp(
            mean(
              log(.data$R)
            )
          )
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },

        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$d
      )

    if (
      any(
        !candidate_metrics$all_R_valid
      ) ||
        anyNA(candidate_metrics$W) ||
        anyNA(candidate_metrics$G)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one relative ARL curve is invalid for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 5 and 6. Construct D1, D2, and A
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    C_d <- sort(
      unique(
        candidate_metrics$d
      )
    )

    D1 <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$OOC_ND == 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    D2 <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$OOC_3A == 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    D12 <- sort(
      intersect(
        D1,
        D2
      )
    )

    if (length(D12) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D1_intersect_D2"

      A <- D12

    } else if (length(D1) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D1"

      A <- D1

    } else if (length(D2) > 0) {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "D2"

      A <- D2

    } else {

      observed_behavior_case <-
        "C_d"

      A <- C_d
    }

    A <- sort(
      unique(A)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 7. Construct U
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    metrics_A <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d %in% A
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$d
      )

    U <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$W <=
          1 + comparison_tolerance
      ) |>
      dplyr::pull(
        .data$d
      ) |>
      unique() |>
      sort()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 8. Apply U or XO selection
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    tied_W_d <- integer(0)
    tied_G_d <- integer(0)

    minimum_W <- NA_real_
    minimum_G <- NA_real_

    if (length(U) > 0) {

      arl_curve_case <- "U"

      d_rec <- as.integer(
        max(U)
      )

      tied_W_d <- d_rec
      tied_G_d <- d_rec

      selection_rule <- paste0(
        "U case: maximum d in U according to Rule 3"
      )

    } else {

      arl_curve_case <- "XO"

      minimum_W <- min(
        metrics_A$W
      )

      tied_W_d <- metrics_A |>
        dplyr::filter(
          values_tied(
            .data$W,
            minimum_W
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$d
        ) |>
        unique() |>
        sort()

      if (length(tied_W_d) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No candidate attained the minimum W value for ",
            "residue ",
            residue_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      metrics_W_tie <- metrics_A |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$d %in%
            tied_W_d
        )

      minimum_G <- min(
        metrics_W_tie$G
      )

      tied_G_d <- metrics_W_tie |>
        dplyr::filter(
          values_tied(
            .data$G,
            minimum_G
          )
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(
          .data$d
        ) |>
        unique() |>
        sort()

      if (length(tied_G_d) == 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No candidate attained the minimum G value among ",
            "the candidates tied on W for residue ",
            residue_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      d_rec <- as.integer(
        max(tied_G_d)
      )

      selection_rule <- paste0(
        "XO case: minimum W over A; minimum G among ",
        "candidates tied on W; maximum d if a tie remains ",
        "according to Rule 3"
      )
    }

    selected_metrics <- metrics_A |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$d == d_rec
      )

    selected_W <- selected_metrics$W[[1]]
    selected_G <- selected_metrics$G[[1]]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Assign one of the eight decision cases
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    case_key <- paste(
      observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case,
      sep = "|"
    )

    case_lookup <- c(
      "D1_intersect_D2|U" = "Case 1",
      "D1_intersect_D2|XO" = "Case 2",
      "D1|U" = "Case 3",
      "D1|XO" = "Case 4",
      "D2|U" = "Case 5",
      "D2|XO" = "Case 6",
      "C_d|U" = "Case 7",
      "C_d|XO" = "Case 8"
    )

    selected_case <- unname(
      case_lookup[
        case_key
      ]
    )

    if (
      length(selected_case) != 1 ||
        is.na(selected_case)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The eight-case decision path could not be assigned ",
          "for residue ",
          residue_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    notes <- character(0)

    if (length(D1) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "D1 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one all-ND event as OOC."
        )
      )
    }

    if (length(D2) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "D2 is empty: every candidate d flagged at least ",
          "one nominal Stage 3A event as OOC."
        )
      )
    }

    if (length(U) == 0) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "U is empty: every candidate in A has at least one ",
          "rho value for which its d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 exceeds ",
          "the corresponding S-chart ARL1 benchmark."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
        length(tied_W_d) > 1
    ) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "Candidate d values ",
          collapse_set(tied_W_d),
          " attained the same minimum W value."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      arl_curve_case == "XO" &&
        length(tied_G_d) > 1
    ) {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "Candidate d values ",
          collapse_set(tied_G_d),
          " remained tied after comparing G. The largest ",
          "tied value of d was selected according to Rule 3."
        )
      )
    }

    if (arl_curve_case == "U") {
      notes <- c(
        notes,
        paste0(
          "The largest d in U was selected according to Rule 3 ",
          "because every candidate in U has an ARL1 curve that ",
          "remains below or touches the S-chart benchmark ",
          "throughout the complete rho grid."
        )
      )
    }

    recommendation_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
      Residue = residue_i,
      recommended_d = d_rec,
      q = q_i,
      s_Z = dplyr::first(candidate_tbl$s_Z),
      sigma_Z = dplyr::first(candidate_tbl$sigma_Z),
      observed_behavior_case =        observed_behavior_case,
      arl_curve_case =        arl_curve_case,
      selected_case =        selected_case,
      selection_rule =        selection_rule,
      C_d_values =        collapse_set(C_d),
      D1_values =        collapse_set(D1),
      D2_values =        collapse_set(D2),
      A_values =        collapse_set(A),
      U_values =        collapse_set(U),
      W_tied_d_values =        collapse_set(tied_W_d),
      G_tied_d_values =        collapse_set(tied_G_d),
      minimum_W =        minimum_W,
      minimum_G_among_W_ties =        minimum_G,
      recommended_W =        selected_W,
      recommended_G =        selected_G,
      selection_path = paste(
        selected_case,
        observed_behavior_case,
        arl_curve_case,
        selection_rule,
        sep = " | "
      ),
      recommendation_notes = paste(
        notes,
        collapse = " | "
      )
    )

    candidate_metrics_output <- candidate_metrics |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        in_C_d =
          .data$d %in% C_d,
        in_D1 =
          .data$d %in% D1,
        in_D2 =
          .data$d %in% D2,
        in_A =
          .data$d %in% A,
        in_U =
          .data$d %in% U,
        selected =
          .data$d == d_rec
      )

    list(
      recommendation =
        recommendation_tbl,
      candidate_metrics =
        candidate_metrics_output
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Fit all residue types and candidate d values
  # ==========================================================

  all_rows <- list()
  all_fit_objects <- list()
  all_candidate_information <- list()
  all_benchmark_models <- list()

  row_id <- 1L
  fit_id <- 1L

  for (rr in seq_along(residue_types)) {

    residue_type_i <- residue_types[[rr]]
    sheet_i <- sheets[[rr]]

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
      message(
        "Processing residue type: ",
        residue_type_i,
        " | sheet: ",
        sheet_i
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1. Initial d = 1 fit to determine q
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fit_q <- d_ccssbu_s(
      file = file,
      equipment_label = equipment_label,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      sheet = sheet_i,
      d = 1,
      n_stage3A_events = n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,
      B = B,
      c_smooth = c_smooth,
      h_min = h_min,
      seed = seed + 1000L * rr + 1L,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =
        scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits =
        scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col = cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =
        cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =
        cluster_round_digits,
      event_col = event_col,
      location_col = location_col,
      result_col = result_col,
      lod_col = lod_col,
      loq_col = loq_col,
      usl_col = usl_col,
      plot_chart = FALSE,
      save_outputs = FALSE,
      return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
      keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE
    )

    event_statistics_q <- extract_event_statistics(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      d_value = 1
    )

    q_residue <- extract_q(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2. Construct benchmark model once per residue
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    stage3a_z_i <- extract_stage3a_z(
      fit = fit_q,
      residue_type = residue_type_i
    )

    mu_0_i <- mean(
      stage3a_z_i
    )

    s_Z_i <- stats::sd(
      stage3a_z_i
    )

    if (
      is.na(mu_0_i) ||
        !is.finite(mu_0_i)
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The Stage 3A mean could not be calculated for ",
          "residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    if (
      is.na(s_Z_i) ||
        !is.finite(s_Z_i) ||
        s_Z_i < 0
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The Stage 3A empirical standard deviation could ",
          "not be calculated for residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    sigma_Z_i <- max(
      s_Z_i,
      h_min
    )

    if (!is.finite(sigma_Z_i) ||sigma_Z_i <= 0) {stop(paste0("sigma_Z must be positive for residue ",residue_type_i,  "."  ) ) }

    benchmark_n_i <- get_benchmark_n(
      residue_type = residue_type_i,
      residue_position = rr,
      event_statistics =event_statistics_q)

    degrees_of_freedom_i <-     benchmark_n_i - 1L

    chi_square_limit_i <- stats::qchisq(p = 1 - alpha,df = degrees_of_freedom_i  )

    UCL_S_i <- sigma_Z_i * sqrt(chi_square_limit_i /degrees_of_freedom_i)

    sigma_1_i <- rho_grid * sigma_Z_i

    benchmark_curve_i <- tibble::tibble(
      rho = rho_grid,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =    chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      S_chart_ARL1 = vapply(
        rho_grid,
        conventional_s_chart_arl1,
        n = benchmark_n_i,
        alpha = alpha,
        FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
      )
    )

    if (
      anyNA(
        benchmark_curve_i$S_chart_ARL1
      )
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "At least one conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark ",
          "could not be calculated for residue ",
          residue_type_i,
          "."
        )
      )
    }

    all_benchmark_models[[residue_type_i]] <- list(
      Residue = residue_type_i,
      stage3a_z = stage3a_z_i,
      mu_0 = mu_0_i,
      s_Z = s_Z_i,
      sigma_Z = sigma_Z_i,
      h_min = h_min,
      benchmark_n = benchmark_n_i,
      degrees_of_freedom =    degrees_of_freedom_i,
      chi_square_limit =      chi_square_limit_i,
      UCL_S = UCL_S_i,
      rho_grid = rho_grid,
      sigma_1 = sigma_1_i,
      benchmark_table =   benchmark_curve_i
    )

    if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
      message(
        "  q = ",
        q_residue,
        " | benchmark n = ",
        benchmark_n_i,
        " | mu_0 = ",
        signif(mu_0_i, 6),
        " | s_Z = ",
        signif(s_Z_i, 6),
        " | sigma_Z = ",
        signif(sigma_Z_i, 6),
        " | UCL_S = ",
        signif(UCL_S_i, 6)
      )
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Steps 1 and 3. Fit d = 1, 2, ..., q
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for (d_i in seq_len(q_residue)) {

      if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message("  Fitting d = ", d_i," of ",  q_residue) }

      if (d_i == 1L) {fit_i <- fit_q} 
      else {fit_i <- d_ccssbu_s(
          file = file,
          equipment_label = equipment_label,
          residue_type = residue_type_i,
          sheet = sheet_i,
          d = d_i,
          n_stage3A_events =      n_stage3A_events,
          target_ARL0 =         target_ARL0,
          B = B,
          c_smooth =        c_smooth,
          h_min =         h_min,
          seed =    seed + 1000L * rr + d_i,
          scale_eligibility_threshold =    scale_eligibility_threshold,
          scale_distinct_digits =     scale_distinct_digits,
          cluster_col =    cluster_col,
          cluster_group_cols =  cluster_group_cols,
          cluster_round_digits =  cluster_round_digits,
          event_col =      event_col,
          location_col =  location_col,
          result_col =    result_col,
          lod_col =       lod_col,
          loq_col =        loq_col,
          usl_col =         usl_col,
          plot_chart = FALSE,
          save_outputs = FALSE,
          return_bootstrap_matrix = FALSE,
          keep_bootstrap_statistics = TRUE )}

      event_statistics_i <- extract_event_statistics(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i, d_value = d_i )

      normalized_data_i <- extract_normalized_data(  fit = fit_i, residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i )

      CL_i <- extract_chart_limit(  fit = fit_i,  limit_type = "CL",  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i   )

      UCL_i <- extract_chart_limit( fit = fit_i,limit_type = "UCL", residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i  )

      calibration_case_i <- extract_calibration_case( fit = fit_i,  residue_type = residue_type_i,  d_value = d_i )

      n_cal_i <- extract_n_cal(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)

      bootstrap_scale_i <-extract_bootstrap_scale(fit = fit_i,residue_type = residue_type_i,d_value = d_i)

      n_bootstrap_i <- length(bootstrap_scale_i )

      if (n_bootstrap_i < 1) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "No bootstrap scale statistics were available for ",
            "residue ",
            residue_type_i,
            " and d = ",
            d_i,
            "."
          )
        )
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Observed OOC counts for Rules 1 and 2
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      all_nd_event_index_i <-    extract_all_nd_event_index(
          fit = fit_i,
          event_statistics =  event_statistics_i,
          normalized_data =  normalized_data_i,
          residue_type =  residue_type_i,
          d_value =   d_i )

      signal_i <- event_statistics_i$S_t >UCL_i

      signal_i[is.na(signal_i)] <- FALSE

      OOC_ND_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Signal_d_selection_S =
            signal_i
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$Event_index %in%
            all_nd_event_index_i,
          .data$Signal_d_selection_S
        )

      OOC_3A_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%  fit_i$D_3A_event_index, .data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_3B_tbl_i <- event_statistics_i |>
        dplyr::mutate(Signal_d_selection_S =signal_i) |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_index %in%fit_i$monitoring_event_index,.data$Signal_d_selection_S)

      OOC_ND_i <- nrow(  OOC_ND_tbl_i )

      OOC_3A_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3A_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3A_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i
      )

      OOC_3B_i <- validate_ooc_count(
        value = fit_i$n_stage3B_ooc,
        value_name = "n_stage3B_ooc",
        residue_type = residue_type_i,
        d_value = d_i
      )

      if (OOC_3A_i != nrow(OOC_3A_tbl_i)) {stop( paste0( "The recalculated Stage 3A OOC count does not ",
            "equal fit$n_stage3A_ooc for residue ",  residue_type_i," and d = ",  d_i,".")) }

      if (OOC_3B_i != nrow(OOC_3B_tbl_i)) {stop(paste0("The recalculated Stage 3B OOC count does not ","equal fit$n_stage3B_ooc for residue ", residue_type_i, " and d = ",d_i,  "."))}

      OOC_ND_events_i <- if ( OOC_ND_i > 0) { paste(OOC_ND_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", " ) } else {""}

      OOC_3A_events_i <- if ( OOC_3A_i > 0) { paste(OOC_3A_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}

      OOC_3B_events_i <- if (OOC_3B_i > 0) {paste(OOC_3B_tbl_i$Event, collapse = ", ")} else {""}

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 3. Candidate-specific ARL1 curves
      # S_b^{*,rho}(d) = rho S_b^*(d)
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      n_signals_i <- vapply(rho_grid,FUN = function(rho_value) {sum(rho_value *bootstrap_scale_i >UCL_i,na.rm = TRUE) }, FUN.VALUE = integer(1))

      p1_i <- n_signals_i / n_bootstrap_i

      ARL1_uncensored_i <- ifelse(p1_i > 0,  1 / p1_i,  Inf )

      expected_truncated_run_length_i <-ifelse( p1_i > 0, (1 -(1 - p1_i)^T_max) / p1_i,T_max )

      ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i <- !is.finite(ARL1_uncensored_i) | ARL1_uncensored_i > T_max

      candidate_shift_tbl_i <-  tibble::tibble(
          rho = rho_grid,
          n_bootstrap =   n_bootstrap_i,
          n_signals =   n_signals_i,
          p1 =  p1_i,
          ARL1 =  ARL1_uncensored_i,
          expected_truncated_run_length =  expected_truncated_run_length_i,
          ARL1_exceeds_T_max =  ARL1_exceeds_T_max_i
        )

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 4. Add conventional S-chart benchmark
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      candidate_rows_i <-
        candidate_shift_tbl_i |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          benchmark_curve_i,
          by = "rho"
        ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Equipment =            equipment_label,
          Residue =            residue_type_i,
          sheet =            as.character(sheet_i),
          d =            as.integer(d_i),
          q =            as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =            calibration_case_i,
          nCal =            as.integer(n_cal_i),
          OOC_ND =            as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A =            as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =            as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          OOC_ND_events =            OOC_ND_events_i,
          OOC_3A_events =            OOC_3A_events_i,
          OOC_3B_events =            OOC_3B_events_i,
          CL =            CL_i,
          UCL =            UCL_i,
          target_ARL0 =            target_ARL0,
          alpha =            alpha,
          B =            B,
          T_max =            T_max,
          .before = 1 ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(relative_ARL_ratio =  .data$ARL1 /.data$S_chart_ARL1)

      all_rows[[row_id]] <-  candidate_rows_i

      fit_object_name <- paste0(residue_type_i, "_d",  d_i)

      all_fit_objects[[fit_id]] <-        fit_i

      names(all_fit_objects)[[fit_id]] <-        fit_object_name

      all_candidate_information[[fit_id]] <-list(
          Residue =            residue_type_i,
          d =            as.integer(d_i),
          q =            as.integer(q_residue),
          calibration_case =            calibration_case_i,
          nCal =            as.integer(n_cal_i),
          calibration_data =            fit_i$calibration_data,
          calibration_status =            fit_i$cluster_calibration_status,
          CL =            CL_i,
          UCL =            UCL_i,
          OOC_ND =            as.integer(OOC_ND_i),
          OOC_3A =            as.integer(OOC_3A_i),
          OOC_3B =            as.integer(OOC_3B_i),
          all_ND_event_index =            all_nd_event_index_i,
          benchmark_n =            as.integer(benchmark_n_i),
          mu_0 =            mu_0_i,
          s_Z =            s_Z_i,
          sigma_Z =            sigma_Z_i,
          rho_grid =            rho_grid,
          sigma_1 =            sigma_1_i,
          degrees_of_freedom =            degrees_of_freedom_i,
          chi_square_limit =            chi_square_limit_i,
          UCL_S =            UCL_S_i,
          bootstrap_scale_statistics =            bootstrap_scale_i,
          event_statistics =            event_statistics_i)

      names(all_candidate_information)[[fit_id]] <- fit_object_name

      row_id <- row_id + 1L
      fit_id <- fit_id + 1L
    }
  }

  if (length(all_rows) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No candidate-specific ARL1 results were generated."
    )
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Combine candidate-specific ARL1 results
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    all_rows
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d,
      .data$rho
    )

  arl1_split <- split(
    arl1_long_tbl,
    factor(
      arl1_long_tbl$Residue,
      levels = residue_types
    ),
    drop = TRUE
  )

  recommendation_outputs <- lapply(
    arl1_split,
    recommend_d_for_residue
  )

  recommendation_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      recommendation_outputs,
      function(x) {
        x$recommendation
      }
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      )
    )

  candidate_metrics_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      recommendation_outputs,
      function(x) {
        x$candidate_metrics
      }
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Add selection information to long-format ARL1 table
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      candidate_metrics_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$d,
          .data$W,
          .data$G,
          .data$in_C_d,
          .data$in_D1,
          .data$in_D2,
          .data$in_A,
          .data$in_U,
          .data$selected), by = c( "Residue","d" ) ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      recommendation_tbl |>
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Residue,
          .data$recommended_d,
          .data$observed_behavior_case,
          .data$arl_curve_case,
          .data$selected_case,
          .data$selection_rule,
          .data$A_values,
          .data$U_values,
          .data$selection_path,
          .data$recommendation_notes
        ),
      by = "Residue") |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      match(
        .data$Residue,
        residue_types
      ),
      .data$d,
      .data$rho
    )

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct wide ARL1 table internally
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_wide_tbl <- arl1_long_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(rho_label = make_rho_label(.data$rho)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      .data$Residue,
      .data$d,
      .data$q,
      .data$calibration_case,
      .data$nCal,
      .data$OOC_ND,
      .data$OOC_3A,
      .data$OOC_3B,
      .data$benchmark_n,
      .data$mu_0,
      .data$s_Z,
      .data$sigma_Z,
      .data$degrees_of_freedom,
      .data$chi_square_limit,
      .data$UCL_S,
      .data$CL,
      .data$UCL,
      .data$W,
      .data$G,
      .data$in_C_d,
      .data$in_D1,
      .data$in_D2,
      .data$in_A,
      .data$in_U,
      .data$selected,
      .data$recommended_d,
      .data$observed_behavior_case,
      .data$arl_curve_case,
      .data$selected_case,
      .data$selection_rule,
      .data$A_values,
      .data$U_values,
      .data$selection_path,
      .data$recommendation_notes,
      .data$rho_label,
      .data$sigma_1,
      .data$S_chart_ARL1,
      .data$ARL1,
      .data$relative_ARL_ratio) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(
        "Residue",
        "d",
        "q",
        "calibration_case",
        "nCal",
        "OOC_ND",
        "OOC_3A",
        "OOC_3B",
        "benchmark_n",
        "mu_0",
        "s_Z",
        "sigma_Z",
        "degrees_of_freedom",
        "chi_square_limit",
        "UCL_S",
        "CL",
        "UCL",
        "W",
        "G",
        "in_C_d",
        "in_D1",
        "in_D2",
        "in_A",
        "in_U",
        "selected",
        "recommended_d",
        "observed_behavior_case",
        "arl_curve_case",
        "selected_case",
        "selection_rule",
        "A_values",
        "U_values",
        "selection_path",
        "recommendation_notes"),
      names_from =        .data$rho_label,
      values_from = c(.data$sigma_1,.data$S_chart_ARL1, .data$ARL1, .data$relative_ARL_ratio),
      names_glue ="{.value}_rho_{rho_label}",
      names_sort =FALSE) |>
    dplyr::arrange( match(.data$Residue,  residue_types), .data$d )

  # ==========================================================
  # Extract recommended d values
  # ==========================================================

  recommended_d_named <- stats::setNames(as.integer( recommendation_tbl$recommended_d), recommendation_tbl$Residue)

  DAR_d <- if ( "DAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)  ) {
    as.integer(      recommended_d_named[["DAR"]]    )  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  CAR_d <- if ("CAR" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) {as.integer(recommended_d_named[["CAR"]])
  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  Mic_d <- if ("Mic" %in% names(recommended_d_named)) { as.integer(recommended_d_named[["Mic"]])
  } else {    NA_integer_  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Construct rounded display versions
  # ==========================================================

  arl1_long_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_long_tbl  )

  arl1_wide_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(  arl1_wide_tbl  )

  recommendation_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    recommendation_tbl  )

  candidate_metrics_display_tbl <- round_numeric_columns(    candidate_metrics_tbl  )

  # ==========================================================
  # Completion messages
  # ==========================================================

  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {

    message(
      "Completed d-CCSSBU-S d selection."
    )

    for (
      ii in seq_len(
        nrow(recommendation_tbl)
      )
    ) {
      message(
        "  ",
        recommendation_tbl$Residue[[ii]],
        ": recommended d = ",
        recommendation_tbl$recommended_d[[ii]],
        " | ",
        recommendation_tbl$selected_case[[ii]],
        " | ",
        recommendation_tbl$arl_curve_case[[ii]]
      )
    }
  }

  # ==========================================================
  # Return all results
  # ==========================================================

  result <- list(

    # Recommended d values
    recommendations =      recommendation_tbl,
    recommendations_display =      recommendation_display_tbl,
    recommended_d =      recommended_d_named,
    DAR_d =      DAR_d,
    CAR_d =      CAR_d,
    Mic_d =      Mic_d,

    # Candidate-level selection metrics
    candidate_metrics =      candidate_metrics_tbl,
    candidate_metrics_display =      candidate_metrics_display_tbl,

    # ARL1 results
    arl1_raw =      arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long =      arl1_long_tbl,
    arl1_long_display =      arl1_long_display_tbl,
    arl1_wide =      arl1_wide_tbl,
    arl1_wide_display =      arl1_wide_display_tbl,

    # Benchmark models
    benchmark_models =      all_benchmark_models,

    # Full fitted chart objects
    fit_objects =      all_fit_objects,

    # Detailed candidate information
    candidate_information =      all_candidate_information,

    # Settings
    benchmark_settings = list(
      target_ARL0 =        target_ARL0,
      alpha =        alpha,
      rho_grid =        rho_grid,
      benchmark_n =        benchmark_n,
      h_min =        h_min,
      T_max =        T_max
    ),

    settings = list(
      equipment_label =        equipment_label,
      residue_types =        residue_types,
      sheets =        sheets,
      n_stage3A_events =        n_stage3A_events,
      target_ARL0 =        target_ARL0,
      alpha =        alpha,
      B =        B,
      c_smooth =        c_smooth,
      h_min =        h_min,
      seed =        seed,
      scale_eligibility_threshold =        scale_eligibility_threshold,
      scale_distinct_digits =        scale_distinct_digits,
      cluster_col =        cluster_col,
      cluster_group_cols =        cluster_group_cols,
      cluster_round_digits =        cluster_round_digits,
      rho_grid =        rho_grid,
      T_max =        T_max,
      benchmark_n =        benchmark_n,
      comparison_tolerance =        comparison_tolerance,
      round_digits =        round_digits
    ),

    call =
      match.call()
  )

  class(result) <- c(
    "d_ccssbu_s_d_selection_arl1",
    "list"
  )

  return(result)
}


render_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "d-CCSSBU-S ARL1 simulation results.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7
) {

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    tbl |>
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label
      ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

  } else {

    tbl |>
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption
      ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )
  }
}

render_d_ccssbu_s_recommendation_tbl <- function(
  tbl,
  caption = "Recommended d values for the d-CCSSBU-S chart.",
  label = NULL,
  font_size = 7,
  show_notes = FALSE
) {

  if (is.null(tbl)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "tbl is NULL. Available outputs are typically ",
        "result$recommendations or ",
        "result$recommendations_display."
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop(
      "tbl must be a data frame."
    )
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop(
      "tbl contains no rows."
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Auto-map old and new output names
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (!"recommended_W" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("W" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_W <- tbl$W
    }
  }

  if (!"recommended_G" %in% names(tbl)) {

    if ("G" %in% names(tbl)) {
      tbl$recommended_G <- tbl$G
    }
  }
required_columns <- c(
  "Residue",
  "recommended_d",
  "q",
  "s_Z",
  "sigma_Z",
  "observed_behavior_case",
  "arl_curve_case",
  "selected_case",
  "selection_rule",
  "A_values",
  "U_values",
  "recommended_W",
  "recommended_G"
)

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Missing column(s): ",
        paste(
          missing_columns,
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        "\n\nAvailable columns:\n",
        paste(
          names(tbl),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  if (!"recommendation_notes" %in% names(tbl)) {
    tbl$recommendation_notes <- ""
  }

  escape_latex_text <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)

    x[is.na(x)] <- ""

    placeholder <- "BACKSLASHPLACEHOLDER"

    x <- gsub("\\\\", placeholder, x)

    x <- gsub(
      "([#$%&_{}])",
      "\\\\\\1",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub(
      "~",
      "\\\\textasciitilde{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x <- gsub("\\^","\\\\textasciicircum{}",  x,  perl = TRUE  )

    x <- gsub(
      placeholder,
      "\\\\textbackslash{}",
      x,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    x
  }

  observed_case_label <- dplyr::case_when(
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1_intersect_D2" ~ "D1 ∩ D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D1" ~ "D1",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "D2" ~ "D2",
    tbl$observed_behavior_case == "C_d" ~ "{1,...,q}",
    TRUE ~ tbl$observed_behavior_case
  )
  display_rule <- dplyr::case_when(
     tbl$arl_curve_case == "U" ~    "max d in U (Rule 3)",

     tbl$arl_curve_case == "XO" ~    "min W; min G; max d if tied (Rule 3)",

     TRUE ~    as.character(tbl$selection_rule)
   )

tbl_display <- tbl |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Residue = as.character(Residue),

    `Rec. d` = recommended_d,

    q = q,

    `sZ/sigZ` = paste0( formatC(s_Z, format = "f", digits = 4), " / ",formatC(sigma_Z, format = "f", digits = 4)),

    Case = as.character(selected_case),

    Behavior = observed_case_label,

    ARL1 = as.character(arl_curve_case),

    A = A_values,

    U = U_values,

    `W(d)` = recommended_W,

    `G(d)` = recommended_G,

    Rule = display_rule

  )

  notes_tbl <- tbl |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      Note = as.character(recommendation_notes)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Note),
      nzchar(trimws(Note))
    )

  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

    table_output <- tbl_display |>
      knitr::kable(
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        label = label,
        escape = TRUE
      ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        latex_options = c(
          "scale_down",
          "hold_position"
        ),
        position = "center",
        font_size = font_size
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")

    if (
      isTRUE(show_notes) &&
      nrow(notes_tbl) > 0
    ) {

      cat("\\vspace{1mm}\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{0.96\\textwidth}\n")
      cat("\\footnotesize\n")
      cat("\\noindent\\textit{Notes.}\n")
      cat("\\begin{description}\n")

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(notes_tbl))) {

        cat(
          paste0(
            "\\item[\\textit{",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Residue[i]),
            ":}] ",
            escape_latex_text(notes_tbl$Note[i]),
            "\n"
          )
        )
      }

      cat("\\end{description}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
    }

  } else {

    table_output <- tbl_display |>
      knitr::kable(
        digits = 4,
        caption = caption,
        escape = TRUE
      ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "condensed",
          "hover",
          "responsive"
        ),
        full_width = FALSE
      )

    cat(as.character(table_output), "\n")
  }

  invisible(tbl_display)
}
```

```{r plot-d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

plot_d_ccssbu_s_arl1_curves <- function(
  tbl,
  equipment_label = "Equipment",
  output_file = NULL,
  residue_order = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),
  width = 9,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  y_log10 = TRUE,
  show_points = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
) {

  required_packages <- c(
    "dplyr",
    "ggplot2",
    "patchwork"
  )

  missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
      required_packages,
      requireNamespace,
      quietly = TRUE,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
  ]

  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_packages,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.data.frame(tbl)) {
    stop("tbl must be a data frame.")
  }

  if (nrow(tbl) == 0) {
    stop("tbl contains no rows.")
  }

  required_columns <- c(
    "Residue",
    "d",
    "rho",
    "ARL1",
    "S_chart_ARL1"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tbl)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following required column(s) are missing from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    length(equipment_label) != 1 ||
    is.na(equipment_label) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(equipment_label))
  ) {
    stop(
      "equipment_label must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (
    length(width) != 1 ||
    is.na(width) ||
    !is.finite(width) ||
    width <= 0
  ) {
    stop("width must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(height) != 1 ||
    is.na(height) ||
    !is.finite(height) ||
    height <= 0
  ) {
    stop("height must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  if (
    length(dpi) != 1 ||
    is.na(dpi) ||
    !is.finite(dpi) ||
    dpi <= 0
  ) {
    stop("dpi must be a positive finite number.")
  }

  residue_order <- unique(
    as.character(residue_order)
  )

  available_residues <- unique(
    as.character(tbl$Residue)
  )

  missing_residues <- setdiff(
    residue_order,
    available_residues
  )

  if (length(missing_residues) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following requested residue type(s) are absent from tbl: ",
      paste(
        missing_residues,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  plot_data <- tbl |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Residue = as.character(Residue),
      d = as.integer(d),
      rho = as.numeric(rho),
      ARL1 = as.numeric(ARL1),
      S_chart_ARL1 = as.numeric(S_chart_ARL1)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Residue %in% residue_order
    )

  invalid_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(d) |
      is.na(rho) |
      !is.finite(rho) |
      rho <= 0 |
      is.na(ARL1) |
      ARL1 <= 0 |
      is.na(S_chart_ARL1) |
      S_chart_ARL1 <= 0
    )

  if (nrow(invalid_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The plotting data contain missing, nonpositive, or ",
        "invalid values of d, rho, ARL1, or S_chart_ARL1."
      )
    )
  }

  duplicate_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::count(
      Residue,
      d,
      rho,
      name = "n_rows"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_rows > 1
    )

  if (nrow(duplicate_rows) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Multiple rows were found for at least one ",
        "Residue, d, and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  benchmark_check <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Residue,
      rho
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_benchmark_values =
        dplyr::n_distinct(S_chart_ARL1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      n_benchmark_values > 1
    )

  if (nrow(benchmark_check) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The conventional S-chart ARL1 benchmark varies ",
        "across d for at least one Residue and rho combination."
      )
    )
  }

  nonfinite_rows <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.finite(ARL1) |
      !is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(nonfinite_rows) > 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        nrow(nonfinite_rows),
        " row(s) with infinite ARL1 values were omitted ",
        "because infinite values cannot be plotted."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  plot_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(ARL1),
      is.finite(S_chart_ARL1)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No finite ARL1 values remain for plotting."
    )
  }

  rho_breaks <- sort(
    unique(plot_data$rho)
  )

  make_residue_plot <- function(
    residue_name
  ) {

    residue_data <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(
        Residue == residue_name
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        d,
        rho
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        d_label = factor(
          paste0("d = ", d),
          levels = paste0(
            "d = ",
            sort(unique(d))
          )
        )
      )

    if (nrow(residue_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No finite plotting data were found for residue ",
        residue_name,
        "."
      )
    }

    benchmark_data <- residue_data |>
      dplyr::select(
        rho,
        S_chart_ARL1
      ) |>
      dplyr::distinct() |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        rho
      )

    residue_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = residue_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = ARL1,
          color = d_label,
          group = d_label
        ),
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

    if (isTRUE(show_points)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = residue_data,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(
            x = rho,
            y = ARL1,
            color = d_label,
            group = d_label
          ),
          size = 1.8,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    residue_plot <- residue_plot +
      ggplot2::geom_line(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1,
          linetype = "S-chart ARL1 benchmark"
        ),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.3,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = benchmark_data,
        mapping = ggplot2::aes(
          x = rho,
          y = S_chart_ARL1
        ),
        color = "black",
        shape = 18,
        size = 2.7,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = rho_breaks,
        labels = formatC(
          rho_breaks,
          format = "f",
          digits = 2
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "S-chart ARL1 benchmark" = "longdash"
        )
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0(
          residue_name,
          " ARL1 curves"
        ),
        x = expression(
          "Multiplicative variability ratio, " * rho
        ),
        y = expression(ARL[1]),
        color = "d-CCSSBU-S candidate"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_bw(
        base_size = base_size
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          hjust = 0
        ),
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
      )

    if (isTRUE(y_log10)) {
      residue_plot <- residue_plot +
        ggplot2::scale_y_log10()
    }

    residue_plot
  }

  residue_plots <- lapply(
    residue_order,
    make_residue_plot
  )

  names(residue_plots) <- residue_order

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    residue_plots,
    ncol = 1,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(
        "d-CCSSBU-S and conventional S-chart ARL1 curves for ",
        equipment_label
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
       "Candidate curves versus the conventional ",
        "S-chart ARL1 benchmark curve."
      ),
      theme = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = base_size + 3,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
          size = base_size,
          hjust = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  if (is.null(output_file)) {

    equipment_file_name <- tolower(
      trimws(equipment_label)
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "[^a-z0-9]+",
      replacement = "-",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    equipment_file_name <- gsub(
      pattern = "^-+|-+$",
      replacement = "",
      x = equipment_file_name
    )

    output_file <- paste0(
      "d-ccssbu-s-arl1-curves-",
      equipment_file_name,
      ".png"
    )
  }

  if (
    length(output_file) != 1 ||
    is.na(output_file) ||
    !nzchar(trimws(output_file))
  ) {
    stop(
      "output_file must be one nonempty character value."
    )
  }

  if (!grepl(
  pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
  x = output_file,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)) {
  output_file <- paste0(
    output_file,
    ".png"
  )
  }
  

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_file,
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )

  message(
    "The ARL1 curve figure was saved to: ",
    normalizePath(
      output_file,
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = FALSE
    )
  )

  invisible(
    list(
      plot = combined_plot,
      panels = residue_plots,
      output_file = output_file,
      plotting_data = plot_data
    )
  )
}
```
