# Discussion

## Equipment D UCL Eestimation by Complete Event Bootstrap or Location-Stratified Bootstrap

```{r bootstrap_event_location_ucl_function}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
bootstrap_event_location_ucl <- function(
    file,
    equipment_label = "Equipment B",
    sheets = c("DAR", "CAR", "Mic"),

    # Bootstrap design
    target_ARL0 = 740,
    B = 20000,
    seed = 123,

    # Input columns
    event_col = "Event",
    location_col = "Location",
    result_col = "Result",
    lod_col = "LOD",
    loq_col = "LOQ",
    usl_col = "USL",

    # Output controls
    keep_bootstrap_statistics = FALSE,
    save_table = FALSE,
    output_file = file.path(
      getwd(),
      "Equipment_B_event_vs_location_bootstrap_UCL.csv"
    )
) {

  # ============================================================
  # 0. Package and argument checks
  # ============================================================

  required_pkgs <- c(
    "readxl",
    "dplyr",
    "stringr",
    "matrixStats"
  )

  missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[
    !(required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages()))
  ]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Please install the following package(s): ",
      paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop("The input file does not exist: ", file)
  }

  if (target_ARL0 <= 1) {
    stop("target_ARL0 must be greater than 1.")
  }

  if (B < 1) {
    stop("B must be a positive integer.")
  }

  B <- as.integer(B)

  alpha <- 1 / target_ARL0
  ucl_probability <- 1 - alpha

  available_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  missing_sheets <- setdiff(  sheets,  available_sheets )

  if (length(missing_sheets) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following requested worksheet(s) were not found: ",
      paste(missing_sheets, collapse = ", "),
      ". Available worksheets: ",
      paste(available_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 1. Helper functions
  # ============================================================

  mad_unscaled <- function(x) {

    x <- x[ !is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {   return(NA_real_)}

    med_x <- stats::median(  x,  na.rm = TRUE )

    stats::median(abs(x - med_x),  na.rm = TRUE )
  }

  is_nd_result <- function(x) {

    x_chr <- trimws(toupper(as.character(x) ) )

    x_chr %in% c(
      "ND",
      "N.D.",
      "N/D",
      "NON-DETECT",
      "NONDETECT",
      "NON DETECT",
      "NOT DETECT"
    )
  }

  extract_event_number <- function(x) {

    x_chr <- trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )

    x_num_direct <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(x_chr)
    )

    x_num_extracted <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        stringr::str_extract(
          x_chr,
          "\\d+$"
        )
      )
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(x_num_direct) ~ x_num_direct,
      !is.na(x_num_extracted) ~ x_num_extracted,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {

    x <- x[
      !is.na(x) &
        is.finite(x)
    ]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    as.numeric(
      stats::quantile(
        x = x,
        probs = probs,
        type = 7,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  calculate_percent_difference <- function(
      location_value,
      event_value) {

    if (is.na(location_value) ||is.na(event_value) ||
      !is.finite(location_value) ||!is.finite(event_value) ||
      event_value == 0) { return(NA_real_)}

    100 * (location_value - event_value ) / event_value
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 2. Process one residue worksheet
  # ============================================================

  analyze_one_residue <- function(
      sheet_name,
      sheet_seed
  ) {

    message(
      "Analyzing ",
      equipment_label,
      ": ",
      sheet_name
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.1 Read worksheet
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    dat_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
      path = file,
      sheet = sheet_name
    )

    dat_raw <- dat_raw |>
      dplyr::rename_with(
        ~ stringr::str_trim(.x)
      )

    result_col_actual <- result_col

    if (
      !(result_col_actual %in% names(dat_raw)) &&
        sheet_name %in% names(dat_raw)
    ) {
      result_col_actual <- sheet_name
    }

    required_cols <- c(
      event_col,
      location_col,
      result_col_actual,
      lod_col,
      loq_col,
      usl_col
    )

    missing_cols <- setdiff(
      required_cols,
      names(dat_raw)
    )

    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " is missing required column(s): ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.2 Replace ND and conduct USL normalization
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    normalized_data <- dat_raw |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Equipment = equipment_label,

        ResidueType = sheet_name,

        Event = extract_event_number( .data[[event_col]]),

        Location = trimws(as.character(   .data[[location_col]] )  ),

        Result_chr = trimws(
          as.character(
            .data[[result_col_actual]]
          )
        ),

        ND_flag = is_nd_result( Result_chr),

        Result_raw = suppressWarnings(  as.numeric(Result_chr)),

        LOD = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            .data[[lod_col]]
          )
        ),

        LOQ = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            .data[[loq_col]]
          )
        ),

        USL = suppressWarnings(
          as.numeric(
            .data[[usl_col]]
          )
        ),

        Result_Replacement_Source =   dplyr::case_when(
            ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~  "ND replaced by LOD",

            ND_flag & is.na(LOD) &  !is.na(LOQ) ~      "ND replaced by LOQ",

            ND_flag & is.na(LOD) &is.na(LOQ) ~"Removed: ND with missing LOD and LOQ",

            !ND_flag &!is.na(Result_raw) ~  "Observed Result",

            TRUE ~"Removed: missing or nonnumeric Result"
          ),

        Result_ND_Replaced =dplyr::case_when(
            ND_flag & !is.na(LOD) ~   LOD,

            ND_flag & is.na(LOD) &!is.na(LOQ) ~   LOQ,

            ND_flag & is.na(LOD) &is.na(LOQ) ~  NA_real_,

            !ND_flag &!is.na(Result_raw) ~  Result_raw,

            TRUE ~  NA_real_
          )
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(Event),
        !is.na(Location),
        Location != "",
        !is.na(Result_ND_Replaced),
        is.finite(Result_ND_Replaced),
        !is.na(USL),
        is.finite(USL),
        USL > 0
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Normalized =
          100 * Result_ND_Replaced / USL
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(Normalized),
        is.finite(Normalized)
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        Event,
        Location
      )

    if (nrow(normalized_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No usable observations remain in worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " after preprocessing."
      )
    }

    n_events <- dplyr::n_distinct(
      normalized_data$Event
    )

    n_locations <- dplyr::n_distinct(
      normalized_data$Location
    )

    if (n_events < 2) {
      stop(
        "Worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " must contain at least two usable events."
      )
    }

    if (n_locations < 1) {
      stop(
        "Worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " has no usable sampling locations."
      )
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.3 Check the sampling-location structure
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    event_location_structure <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::group_by(Event) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_observations = dplyr::n(),

        n_locations =
          dplyr::n_distinct(Location),

        location_set = paste(
          sort(unique(Location)),
          collapse = " | "
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
      )

    n_distinct_location_sets <-
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        event_location_structure$location_set
      )

    if (n_distinct_location_sets > 1) {
      warning(
        "Worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " contains ",
        n_distinct_location_sets,
        " different event-level sampling-location sets. ",
        "The location-stratified bootstrap forms synthetic events ",
        "using all location strata represented in the worksheet, ",
        "whereas the event bootstrap preserves each historical ",
        "event's original sampling-location set."
      )
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # 2.4 Calculate statistics for complete historical events
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    event_statistics <- normalized_data |>
      dplyr::group_by(Event) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        L_t = stats::median(
          Normalized,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        S_t = mad_unscaled(
          Normalized
        ),

        n_observations = dplyr::n(),

        n_locations =          dplyr::n_distinct(Location),

        n_ND = sum(
          ND_flag,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(L_t),
        is.finite(L_t),
        !is.na(S_t),
        is.finite(S_t)
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(Event)

    if (nrow(event_statistics) < 2) {
      stop(
        "Worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        " has fewer than two usable complete-event statistics."
      )
    }

    # ==========================================================
    # 3. Unsmoothed location-stratified bootstrap
    # ==========================================================

    location_data <- split(
      normalized_data$Normalized,
      normalized_data$Location
    )

    location_data <- lapply(
      location_data,
      function(z) {
        z[
          !is.na(z) &
            is.finite(z)
        ]
      }
    )

    location_data <- location_data[
      lengths(location_data) > 0
    ]

    location_data <- location_data[
      sort(names(location_data))
    ]

    if (length(location_data) == 0) {
      stop(
        "No valid location strata remain for worksheet ",
        sheet_name,
        "."
      )
    }

    set.seed(
      sheet_seed + 1L
    )

    location_bootstrap_matrix <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = B,
      ncol = length(location_data)
    )

    colnames(location_bootstrap_matrix) <-      names(location_data)

    for (r in seq_along(location_data)) {

      z_r <- location_data[[r]]

      # Sample only observed normalized values.
      # No smoothing noise is added.
      location_bootstrap_matrix[, r] <-
        sample(
          x = z_r,
          size = B,
          replace = TRUE
        )
    }

    if (ncol(location_bootstrap_matrix) == 1) {

      L_location_boot <-        location_bootstrap_matrix[, 1]

      S_location_boot <-        rep(0, B)

    } else {

      L_location_boot <-
        matrixStats::rowMedians(
          location_bootstrap_matrix,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

      location_absolute_deviations <-
        abs(
          sweep(
            x = location_bootstrap_matrix,
            MARGIN = 1,
            STATS = L_location_boot,
            FUN = "-"
          )
        )

      S_location_boot <-
        matrixStats::rowMedians(
          location_absolute_deviations,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    UCL_L_location <- fast_quantile(
      L_location_boot,
      probs = ucl_probability
    )

    UCL_S_location <- fast_quantile(
      S_location_boot,
      probs = ucl_probability
    )

    # ==========================================================
    # 4. Complete-event bootstrap
    # ==========================================================

    set.seed(
      sheet_seed + 2L
    )

    sampled_event_rows <- sample.int(
      n = nrow(event_statistics),
      size = B,
      replace = TRUE
    )

    L_event_boot <-
      event_statistics$L_t[
        sampled_event_rows
      ]

    S_event_boot <-
      event_statistics$S_t[
        sampled_event_rows
      ]

    UCL_L_event <- fast_quantile(
      L_event_boot,
      probs = ucl_probability
    )

    UCL_S_event <- fast_quantile(
      S_event_boot,
      probs = ucl_probability
    )

    # ==========================================================
    # 5. Compare the resulting UCLs
    # ==========================================================

    Delta_UCL_L <-      UCL_L_location -      UCL_L_event

    Percent_Delta_UCL_L <-
      calculate_percent_difference(
        location_value = UCL_L_location,
        event_value = UCL_L_event
      )

    Delta_UCL_S <-      UCL_S_location -      UCL_S_event

    Percent_Delta_UCL_S <-
      calculate_percent_difference(
        location_value = UCL_S_location,
        event_value = UCL_S_event
      )

    comparison_row <- data.frame(
      ResidueType = sheet_name,

      n_events = nrow(event_statistics),

      n_locations =        length(location_data),

      n_distinct_event_location_sets =        n_distinct_location_sets,

      B = B,

      target_ARL0 = target_ARL0,

      alpha = alpha,

      UCL_L_location = UCL_L_location,

      UCL_L_event = UCL_L_event,

      Delta_UCL_L = Delta_UCL_L,

      Percent_Delta_UCL_L =        Percent_Delta_UCL_L,

      UCL_S_location = UCL_S_location,

      UCL_S_event = UCL_S_event,

      Delta_UCL_S = Delta_UCL_S,

      Percent_Delta_UCL_S =        Percent_Delta_UCL_S,

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    location_strata_summary <- data.frame(
      ResidueType = sheet_name,

      Location = names(location_data),

      n = lengths(location_data),

      Median = vapply(
        location_data,
        stats::median,
        numeric(1),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      MAD = vapply(
        location_data,
        mad_unscaled,
        numeric(1)
      ),

      Min = vapply(
        location_data,
        min,
        numeric(1),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Max = vapply(
        location_data,
        max,
        numeric(1),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    details <- list(
      residue_type = sheet_name,

      normalized_data =        normalized_data,

      event_statistics =        event_statistics,

      event_location_structure =        event_location_structure,

      location_strata_summary =        location_strata_summary,

      UCL_L_location =        UCL_L_location,

      UCL_S_location =        UCL_S_location,

      UCL_L_event =        UCL_L_event,

      UCL_S_event =        UCL_S_event,

      comparison =        comparison_row
    )

    if (keep_bootstrap_statistics) {

      details$bootstrap_statistics <- list(
        L_location = L_location_boot,
        S_location = S_location_boot,
        L_event = L_event_boot,
        S_event = S_event_boot
      )

    } else {

      details$bootstrap_statistics <- NULL
    }

    details
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 6. Analyze DAR, CAR, and Mic
  # ============================================================

  residue_results <- lapply(
    seq_along(sheets),
    function(i) {

      analyze_one_residue(
        sheet_name = sheets[i],
        sheet_seed = seed + 1000L * i
      )
    }
  )

  names(residue_results) <- sheets

  comparison_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      residue_results,
      function(x) {
        x$comparison
      }
    )
  )

  comparison_table <- comparison_table |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::starts_with("UCL_"),
        ~ round(.x, 6)
      ),

      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::starts_with("Delta_"),
        ~ round(.x, 6)
      ),

      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::starts_with("Percent_Delta_"),
        ~ round(.x, 3)
      )
    )

  if (save_table) {

    utils::write.csv(
      x = comparison_table,
      file = output_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    message(
      "Comparison table saved to: ",
      output_file
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # 7. Return results
  # ============================================================

  output <- list(
    method =
      paste0(
        "Unsmoothed location-stratified bootstrap versus ",
        "complete-event bootstrap"
      ),

    equipment_label =      equipment_label,

    file =      file,

    sheets =      sheets,

    target_ARL0 =      target_ARL0,

    alpha =      alpha,

    ucl_probability =      ucl_probability,

    B =      B,

    seed =      seed,

    location_bootstrap_smoothing =FALSE,

    delta_definition ="Delta = UCL_location - UCL_event",

    percent_delta_definition =
      paste0(
        "Percent Delta = 100 * ",
        "(UCL_location - UCL_event) / UCL_event"
      ),

    comparison_table =      comparison_table,

    residue_results =      residue_results,

    output_file = if (save_table) {
      output_file
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )

  class(output) <- c(
    "bootstrap_event_location_ucl",
    "list"
  )

  print(comparison_table)

  return(output)
}
```

## Table 8 on the Effect of Sample Size, Location Dependence, Complete-Event Bootstrap, Location-Stratified Bootstrap, and Realzied ARL0

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

simulate_event_location_ucl <- function(
    n_historical_events = 100000,
    n_locations = 10,
    location_means = seq(1.1, 2.0, by = 0.1),
    event_variance = 1,
    residual_variance = 3,
    B = 2000000,
    bootstrap_chunk_size = 100000,
    n_future_events = 1000000,
    future_chunk_size = 100000,
    target_ARL0 = 740,
    seed = 123
) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Argument checks
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(location_means) != n_locations) {
    stop(
      "The length of location_means must equal n_locations."
    )
  }

  if (n_historical_events < 2) {
    stop(
      "n_historical_events must be at least 2."
    )
  }

  if (n_locations < 2) {
    stop(
      "n_locations must be at least 2."
    )
  }

  if (event_variance < 0) {
    stop(
      "event_variance cannot be negative."
    )
  }

  if (residual_variance <= 0) {
    stop(
      "residual_variance must be positive."
    )
  }

  if (B < 1) {
    stop(
      "B must be positive."
    )
  }

  if (n_future_events < 1) {
    stop(
      "n_future_events must be positive."
    )
  }

  if (target_ARL0 <= 1) {
    stop(
      "target_ARL0 must be greater than 1."
    )
  }

  alpha <-  1 / target_ARL0

  ucl_probability <-    1 - alpha

  marginal_variance <-    event_variance +    residual_variance

  marginal_sd <-    sqrt(marginal_variance)

  within_event_correlation <-    event_variance /  marginal_variance

  # Expected number of historical observations above the
  # theoretical target quantile.
  expected_historical_tail_count <- n_historical_events / target_ARL0

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: calculate row medians.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  row_median <- function(x) {
    apply(
      x,
      MARGIN = 1,
      FUN = median
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: calculate row-wise unscaled MAD.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  row_mad_unscaled <- function(x, row_medians = NULL) {

    if (is.null(row_medians)) {
      row_medians <- row_median(x)
    }

    apply(
      abs(x - row_medians),
      MARGIN = 1,
      FUN = median
    )
  }

  fast_quantile <- function(x, probs) {

    as.numeric(
      stats::quantile(
        x = x,
        probs = probs,
        type = 7,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1. Generate correlated historical events.
  #
  # X_ir = mu_r + E_i + epsilon_ir
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(seed)

  event_effects <- stats::rnorm(
    n = n_historical_events,
    mean = 0,
    sd = sqrt(event_variance)
  )

  residual_errors <- matrix(
    stats::rnorm(
      n = n_historical_events * n_locations,
      mean = 0,
      sd = sqrt(residual_variance)
    ),
    nrow = n_historical_events,
    ncol = n_locations
  )

  historical_data <-residual_errors +  event_effects +
    matrix(
      location_means,
      nrow = n_historical_events,
      ncol = n_locations,
      byrow = TRUE
    )

  colnames(historical_data) <-  paste0( "Location_",  seq_len(n_locations)    )

  # Remove the residual-error matrix after constructing the data.
  rm(residual_errors)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 2. Calculate observed event statistics.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  L_observed <-    row_median(historical_data)

  S_observed <-
    row_mad_unscaled(
      historical_data,
      row_medians = L_observed
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3. Complete-event bootstrap.
  #
  # With 100,000 events, the target empirical quantile is
  # estimable. The bootstrap is retained to match the original
  # procedure.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(seed + 1L)

  event_bootstrap_indices <- sample.int(
    n = n_historical_events,
    size = B,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  L_event_bootstrap <-    L_observed[event_bootstrap_indices]

  S_event_bootstrap <-    S_observed[event_bootstrap_indices]

  UCL_L_event <- fast_quantile(
    L_event_bootstrap,
    probs = ucl_probability
  )

  UCL_S_event <- fast_quantile(
    S_event_bootstrap,
    probs = ucl_probability
  )

  rm(
    event_bootstrap_indices,
    L_event_bootstrap,
    S_event_bootstrap
  )

  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 4. Location-stratified bootstrap in chunks.
  #
  # Storing a 2,000,000 x 10 matrix can consume substantial
  # memory. The bootstrap statistics are therefore calculated
  # in smaller chunks.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(seed + 2L)

  L_location_bootstrap <-    numeric(B)

  S_location_bootstrap <-    numeric(B)

  start_index <-  1L

  while (start_index <= B) {

    end_index <- min( start_index + bootstrap_chunk_size - 1L,  B  )

    current_size <-      end_index - start_index + 1L

    location_bootstrap_chunk <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = current_size,
      ncol = n_locations
    )

    for (r in seq_len(n_locations)) {

      sampled_indices <- sample.int(
        n = n_historical_events,
        size = current_size,
        replace = TRUE
      )

      location_bootstrap_chunk[, r] <-  historical_data[sampled_indices,r]
    }

    L_chunk <-      row_median(location_bootstrap_chunk)

    S_chunk <-      row_mad_unscaled(
        location_bootstrap_chunk,
        row_medians = L_chunk
      )

    L_location_bootstrap[
      start_index:end_index
    ] <- L_chunk

    S_location_bootstrap[
      start_index:end_index
    ] <- S_chunk

    rm(
      location_bootstrap_chunk,
      sampled_indices,
      L_chunk,
      S_chunk
    )

    start_index <-    end_index + 1L
  }

  UCL_L_location <- fast_quantile(
    L_location_bootstrap,
    probs = ucl_probability
  )

  UCL_S_location <- fast_quantile(
    S_location_bootstrap,
    probs = ucl_probability
  )

  rm(
    L_location_bootstrap,
    S_location_bootstrap
  )

  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 5. Compare the estimated UCLs.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  Delta_L <-    UCL_L_location -    UCL_L_event

  Delta_S <-    UCL_S_location -    UCL_S_event

  Percent_Delta_L <-    100 * Delta_L /    UCL_L_event

  Percent_Delta_S <-  100 * Delta_S /    UCL_S_event

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 6. Evaluate realized ARL0 using independent future
  # correlated events.
  #
  # The future events are generated from the true event model,
  # not from either bootstrap distribution.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(seed + 3L)

  n_processed <-  0L

  signals_L_event <-  0L

  signals_L_location <-   0L

  signals_S_event <-    0L

  signals_S_location <-   0L

  while (n_processed < n_future_events) {

    current_size <- min(
      future_chunk_size,
      n_future_events - n_processed
    )

    future_event_effects <- stats::rnorm(
      n = current_size,
      mean = 0,
      sd = sqrt(event_variance)
    )

    future_residual_errors <- matrix(
      stats::rnorm(
        n = current_size * n_locations,
        mean = 0,
        sd = sqrt(residual_variance)
      ),
      nrow = current_size,
      ncol = n_locations
    )

    future_data <-  future_residual_errors +  future_event_effects +
      matrix(
        location_means,
        nrow = current_size,
        ncol = n_locations,
        byrow = TRUE
      )

    L_future <-     row_median(future_data)

    S_future <-   row_mad_unscaled( future_data,row_medians = L_future)

    signals_L_event <-  signals_L_event +   sum(L_future > UCL_L_event)

    signals_L_location <-   signals_L_location +  sum(L_future > UCL_L_location)

    signals_S_event <-signals_S_event +   sum(S_future > UCL_S_event)

    signals_S_location <-   signals_S_location +  sum(S_future > UCL_S_location)

    n_processed <-      n_processed +      current_size

    rm(
      future_event_effects,
      future_residual_errors,
      future_data,
      L_future,
      S_future
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 7. False-alarm probabilities and realized ARL0.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  p_L_event <-    signals_L_event /    n_future_events

  p_L_location <-    signals_L_location /    n_future_events

  p_S_event <-    signals_S_event /    n_future_events

  p_S_location <-    signals_S_location /    n_future_events

  ARL0_L_event <-    ifelse(  p_L_event > 0,1 / p_L_event,Inf  )

  ARL0_L_location <-    ifelse(  p_L_location > 0,  1 / p_L_location,   Inf  )

  ARL0_S_event <-  ifelse(p_S_event > 0,1 / p_S_event,  Inf  )

  ARL0_S_location <-  ifelse(   p_S_location > 0,   1 / p_S_location,  Inf)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 8. Summary tables.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  comparison_table <- data.frame(
    Statistic = c(  "L",  "S"  ),

    UCL_event = c(UCL_L_event,  UCL_S_event ),

    UCL_location = c( UCL_L_location, UCL_S_location),

    Delta = c(  Delta_L,  Delta_S  ),

    Percent_Delta = c(  Percent_Delta_L,  Percent_Delta_S ),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  ARL0_table <- data.frame(
    Statistic = rep(
      c("L", "S"),
      each = 2
    ),

    Method = rep(
      c(
        "Complete-event",
        "Location-stratified"
      ),
      times = 2
    ),

    UCL = c(
      UCL_L_event,
      UCL_L_location,
      UCL_S_event,
      UCL_S_location
    ),

    Number_of_signals = c(
      signals_L_event,
      signals_L_location,
      signals_S_event,
      signals_S_location
    ),

    False_alarm_probability = c(
      p_L_event,
      p_L_location,
      p_S_event,
      p_S_location
    ),

    Realized_ARL0 = c(
      ARL0_L_event,
      ARL0_L_location,
      ARL0_S_event,
      ARL0_S_location
    ),

    Nominal_ARL0 = rep( target_ARL0,4),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 9. Empirical covariance and correlation.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  empirical_covariance <-
    stats::cov(historical_data)

  empirical_correlation <-
    stats::cor(historical_data)

  result <- list(
    seed =      seed,

    n_historical_events =      n_historical_events,

    n_locations =      n_locations,

    B =     B,

    n_future_events =      n_future_events,

    target_ARL0 =      target_ARL0,

    alpha =      alpha,

    ucl_probability =      ucl_probability,

    expected_historical_tail_count =      expected_historical_tail_count,

    marginal_variance =      marginal_variance,

    marginal_sd =      marginal_sd,

    theoretical_within_event_correlation =      within_event_correlation,

    empirical_covariance =      empirical_covariance,

    empirical_correlation =      empirical_correlation,

    comparison_table =      comparison_table,

    ARL0_table =      ARL0_table
  )

  class(result) <- c(
    "simulate_event_location_ucl",
    "list"
  )

  print(comparison_table)
  print(ARL0_table)

  return(result)
}
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# ============================================================
# Combined simulation design
#
# Historical calibration sample sizes:
#   n_Hist = 100 and 100,000
#
# Dependence scenarios:
#   Var(E_i) = 0.0, 0.1, and 1.0
#
# Total marginal variance is fixed at 4:
#   event_variance + residual_variance = 4
#
# Each combination is evaluated using:
#   - 10 sampling locations
#   - 2,000,000 bootstrap replications
#   - 1,000,000 independent future in-control events
#   - nominal ARL0 = 740
# ============================================================

historical_sample_sizes <- c(100L,100000L)

event_variance_scenarios <- data.frame(
  Scenario = c(
    "No event variation",
    "Small event variation",
    "Moderate event variation"
  ),
  Event_variance = c( 0.0,0.1,1.0 ),
  Residual_variance = c(4.0,3.9,3.0 ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

event_variance_scenarios$Marginal_variance <-event_variance_scenarios$Event_variance +
  event_variance_scenarios$Residual_variance

event_variance_scenarios$Within_event_correlation <-event_variance_scenarios$Event_variance /
  event_variance_scenarios$Marginal_variance

# ============================================================
# Run the complete 2 x 3 simulation design
#
# 2 historical sample sizes x 3 dependence scenarios x2 statistics (L and S)
# =12 rows in the final table
# ============================================================

table9_result_rows <- list()
result_row_id <- 1L
for (n_historical_i in historical_sample_sizes) {

  for (scenario_i in seq_len(nrow(event_variance_scenarios))) {

    event_variance_i <-event_variance_scenarios$Event_variance[scenario_i]
    residual_variance_i <-event_variance_scenarios$Residual_variance[scenario_i]
    correlation_i <-event_variance_scenarios$Within_event_correlation[scenario_i]
    scenario_name_i <-event_variance_scenarios$Scenario[scenario_i]

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Use a reproducible seed specific to each combination of
    # historical sample size and dependence scenario.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    seed_i <-123L +1000L * (scenario_i - 1L) +ifelse(n_historical_i == 100L,0L,10000L)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Run the simulation.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    simulation_i <- simulate_event_location_ucl(
        n_historical_events = n_historical_i,
        n_locations = 10,
        location_means =seq(1.1,2.0,by = 0.1),
        event_variance = event_variance_i,
        residual_variance = residual_variance_i,
        B =2000000,
        bootstrap_chunk_size =100000,
        n_future_events = 1000000,
        future_chunk_size = 100000,
        target_ARL0 = 740,
        seed = seed_i
      )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract UCL-comparison and realized-ARL0 results.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    comparison_i <- simulation_i$comparison_table
    arl0_i <- simulation_i$ARL0_table

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Construct the two rows, L and S, for this combination.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    table9_result_rows[[result_row_id]] <- data.frame(
      Historical_events =  n_historical_i,
      Scenario = scenario_name_i,
      Event_variance = event_variance_i,
      Residual_variance = residual_variance_i,
      Correlation = correlation_i,
      Statistic = comparison_i$Statistic,
      UCL_event = comparison_i$UCL_event,
      UCL_location = comparison_i$UCL_location,
      Delta = comparison_i$Delta,
      Percent_Delta = comparison_i$Percent_Delta,
      
      ARL0_event = c(
        arl0_i$Realized_ARL0[arl0_i$Statistic == "L" &arl0_i$Method == "Complete-event"],
        arl0_i$Realized_ARL0[arl0_i$Statistic == "S" &arl0_i$Method == "Complete-event"]),

      ARL0_location = c(
        arl0_i$Realized_ARL0[arl0_i$Statistic == "L" &arl0_i$Method == "Location-stratified"],
        arl0_i$Realized_ARL0[arl0_i$Statistic == "S" &arl0_i$Method == "Location-stratified"]),

      FAR_event = c(
        arl0_i$False_alarm_probability[arl0_i$Statistic == "L" &arl0_i$Method == "Complete-event"],
        arl0_i$False_alarm_probability[arl0_i$Statistic == "S" &arl0_i$Method == "Complete-event"]),

      FAR_location = c(
        arl0_i$False_alarm_probability[arl0_i$Statistic == "L" & arl0_i$Method == "Location-stratified"],
        arl0_i$False_alarm_probability[arl0_i$Statistic =="S" & arl0_i$Method=="Location-stratified"]),
      
      stringsAsFactors =    FALSE
    )

    result_row_id <-  result_row_id + 1L

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Remove large temporary simulation objects before running
    # the next combination.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    rm( simulation_i, comparison_i, arl0_i)
    gc( verbose = FALSE )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Combine all simulation results.
#
# Within each dependence scenario and statistic, n_Hist = 100
# is followed immediately by n_Hist = 100,000 so that the
# finite-historical-sample effect can be compared directly.
# ============================================================

table9_combined_simulation <-
  dplyr::bind_rows( table9_result_rows) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Event_variance,Statistic,Historical_events)

# ============================================================
# Prepare the final manuscript table.
# ============================================================

table9_combined_tibble <- table9_combined_simulation |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    `$n_{\\mathrm{Hist}}$` =      Historical_events,
    `$\\sigma_E^2$` =      Event_variance,
    `$\\rho$` =      Correlation,
    Stat =dplyr::if_else(Statistic == "L","$L$","$S$" ),
    `$UCL_{\\mathrm{Evt}}$` =      UCL_event,
    `$UCL_{\\mathrm{Loc}}$` =      UCL_location,
    `$\\Delta\\%$` =      Percent_Delta,
    `$ARL_{0,\\mathrm{Evt}}$` =      ARL0_event,
    `$ARL_{0,\\mathrm{Loc}}$` =      ARL0_location) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: "Event size and within-event dependence on complete-event and location-stratified bootstrap UCLs and realized ARL0"
#| label: tbl-bootstrap-sample-size-dependence

table9_combined_tibble |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = c( 0,1,3,0,4,4,2,1,1),
    align = c("r","r","r","c","r","r","r","r","r"),
    col.names = c(
      "$n_{\\mathrm{Hist}}$",
      "$\\sigma_E^2$",
      "$\\rho$",
      "Stat.",
      "$UCL_{\\mathrm{Evt}}$",
      "$UCL_{\\mathrm{Loc}}$",
      "$\\Delta\\%$",
      "$ARL_{0,\\mathrm{Evt}}$",
      "$ARL_{0,\\mathrm{Loc}}$"
    ),
    escape = FALSE) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"), position = "center",font_size = 8)
```


## Numbers and proportions of ND and non-ND events for Equipment A and Equipment B

```{r}
#| label: tbl-equipment-ab-nd-event-summary
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| tbl-cap: "Numbers and proportions of ND and non-ND events for Equipment A and Equipment B."

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

summarize_nd_events <- function(
    file,
    equipment_label,
    sheets = c("DAR", "CAR"),
    event_col = "Event",
    result_col = "Result") {

  purrr::map_dfr(
    sheets,
    function(sheet_i) {

      data_i <- readxl::read_excel(
        path = file,
        sheet = sheet_i
      ) |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(.data[[event_col]]),
          !is.na(.data[[result_col]])
        )

      event_tbl <- data_i |>
        dplyr::group_by(
          Event = .data[[event_col]]
        ) |>
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_distinct_results =
            dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[result_col]]),
          ND_event =
            n_distinct_results == 1,
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      n_total <- nrow(event_tbl)
      n_ND <- sum(event_tbl$ND_event)
      n_non_ND <- n_total - n_ND

      tibble::tibble(
        Equipment = equipment_label,
        Residue = sheet_i,
        `Total events` = n_total,
        `ND events` = n_ND,
        `Non-ND events` = n_non_ND,
        `ND (%)` = 100 * n_ND / n_total,
        `Non-ND (%)` = 100 * n_non_ND / n_total
      )
    }
  )
}

# Equipment A and B
equipment_ab_nd_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarize_nd_events(
    file = file,
    equipment_label = "Equipment A"
  ),
  summarize_nd_events(
    file = file1,
    equipment_label = "Equipment B"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Equipment,
    Residue
  )

# One combined table
equipment_ab_nd_summary |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    digits = 2,
    align = c(
      "l", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"
    ),
    escape = TRUE
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c(
      "hold_position",
      "scale_down"
    ),
    position = "center",
    font_size = 8
  ) |>
  cat()
```
